{#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, not met your dad, but... heard plenty about him. Shame, might've gotten on better with him than the rest. Likes his metals and gemstones and such as I'm to understand, so... we'd have that at least.
Your mum and dad are both all right, ain't they? This Chronos business must be pretty tough for them, if they're anything like mine. Although they don't seem anything like mine last time I checked.

Been living under the auspices of the old Witch of the Crossroads, {#Emph}huh? {#Prev}Not met her face to face. Keeps to herself, so I scarce believed it when Apollo said that she'd reached out with something important. Turns out, it was {#Emph}you!
So Mum gave you her blessing, just like {#Emph}that? {#Prev}Hard won's the favor of Queen Hera. Whilst mine... reckon it's a bit easier to come by...

Got off on the wrong foot from the first, me and my mum. Can you blame her? Imagine seeing splendorous Apollo and Athena and so on, thinking, {#Emph}oi, I want to make me one of those! {#Prev}But instead, {#Emph}heheheh{#Prev}, you make me.
Haven't the faintest what Hermes is up to. Where is he? Best make hisself useful, else I'm taking back the sandals {#Emph}and {#Prev}the hat! And then we'll see how blasted quick he is!
When old Hestia said she liked you, 'twas all I needed to hear. The forge would be no good if not for her! She sparks the flame, I bend the metal, and {#Emph}you {#Prev}get the benefits.
Now what is {#Emph}that {#Prev}you've got in hand there, let me see! Mayhap another Aspect of some sort, 'cept... {#Emph}augh{#Prev}, not seen anything like that before. I'm proper jealous now!

{#Emph}Ohh {#Prev}now what is that you've got, witchie? If I know anything of weaponcraft then that is {#Emph}definitely {#Prev}not from around here. Must still be one of those Nocturnal Arms of yours. Go on, give us a show!

While back, made your mum and dad bit of a housewarming gift, guess you could say. Scale model of Dad's palace here, for you Underworld lot to remember us by! That Chronos better not have scrapped the thing...
The Titan really nestled up right in your mum and dad's House, ain't that right? Now that's properly offensive... somehow more than sending all his armies after us!
You seen that Icarus flying about? At first I took him for some giant ghostly bird, but... it's the kid of Daedalus all right! Reckon he made his latest wings hisself. He's not too bad!
See you still got that Adamant Shard I sent over before! Just a bit of scrap, really, but... it's a shiny one, and has some decent heft. And I can use it to pinpoint you {#Emph}quick!
That bit of Adamant you got from me... it's come in handy, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Pure as it gets, too! I hadn't thought you'd end up using it to call on me this much but... I don't mind at all.

My mum or dad mentioned our last resort, did they? The way some of my Boons go {#Emph}clang{#Prev}, imagine that but bigger by, oh... let's just say {#Emph}a lot. {#Prev}Not keen to ever use it, mind, as then my forge would go {#Emph}kaboom!

I like making armaments fit for killing mayhap one, two, let's say up to fifteen at a time? But more than that at once takes all the sport away! Mum and Dad don't get it, they just want to kill 'em all. Ares kind of gets it, though.

Keep a secret, witchie? The last resort my mum and dad asked me to build would never work. Our king and queen commissioned it to feel like they had everything in hand. I gave 'em that feeling, but... that's all I'll give 'em.
Must like to run about don't you? Me, at this point I would rather sit. And so I do! Won't find a better set of legs than this anyplace besides on Aphrodite herself! Yet even still.

All right, that's called Revaal, I think, that skull you got? Ain't exactly my mental picture of a weapon, liable to give me night terrors in fact, but... then I'll be the first to say, {#Emph}whatever works!

So, you're a witch or something, I'm to understand? Then what do you need {#Emph}me {#Prev}for? Mayhap that fancy magick of yours ain't all it's cracked up to be! {#Emph}My {#Prev}work, witchie, is reliable.

Those mortals, they sure got it rough of late. Sometimes I think there's just so blasted many of them now. More suffering and such! {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, reckon that's life! Don't get any say in being born, then do what we can.

Oi what I said before, 'bout more mortals begetting more suffering and the like? Aphrodite, she reminded me there's more to it than that. And maybe she's right. It's just, I reckon the bad in things is easier to spot...
Where'd you get off to, witchie? The Underworld's gutter from the looks of it, all cold and wet... piss-poor working conditions, that much is clear.
You've met most of the lot up here by now. So now you know how come I'm cooped up in this forge. The work needs doing, not to mention it's less tiring than being with the family all the time.
Oi, you made it all the way up to the mountain earlier? I'd give you a tour of the old forge next time, it's just... it's sealed up. Damn near impossible to find! Security's sake.
Got a funny feeling something different's going on, as if... {#Emph}eh{#Prev}, I don't even know! Strange forces are afoot, witchie. Right stranger than the forces gathered here!
Oi how'd you get there so damn quick, witchie? Mayhap some of your witchie stuff, but I've got something more reliable here just in case.
Heard you talked to mum and dad, face to face! Not even {#Emph}I {#Prev}get to do that much. Must have been right nervous meeting 'em. Or mayhap not considering what you did to get there.

Not letting you back in the Palace, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Don't take it personal, it's just our bloody pride! Mum and dad aren't keen on taking guests till everything is {#Emph}perfect{#Prev}, but... it never really is.

For all these scuffles with Prometheus, reminds me there was once this lass who, after right mean circumstances, accidentally cursed her kind forevermore. Long story long ago, but... I always thought mayhap she cursed us, too.
No telling how many cousins I got, but you're another, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}You're getting special treatment only 'cause my mum and dad, they asked me real nice. Don't mind the extra work!
Ran into no-eyed Polyphemus, so I hear? Mean bastard, big, all meat and muscle. Could've used {#Emph}that {#Prev}one at the old forge. Ah well! Hope he doesn't try to chew you up or nothing!

{#Emph}Ahh{#Prev}, Uncle Poseidon's been of some assistance, then? {#Emph}Heh! {#Prev}Reckon it's more welcome than him stomping uninvited in my forge, all sopping wet, filling the place with steam. {#Emph}Psh. {#Prev}What a kidder!

This lot up here act like they all was born with all the talent in the world! Mayhap Apollo and Athena, sure, and Artemis, and Hermes... Aphrodite definitely, too, but, {#Emph}erm... point is! {#Prev}Most of us, we got to {#Emph}work {#Prev}at things before {#Emph}we're {#Prev}any good.
So we've got Titan problems real close to home! Blasted shame about Prometheus, but then... I reckon if Dad chained {#Emph}me {#Prev}up and had an Eagle chew my liver everyday, I'd be mad too.
Don't want to get involved in all the ugly business with Prometheus and Dad. They won't be sipping Ambrosia anytime soon... but at least nobody's getting livers eaten now.
Well, if it ain't my finest client! Reckon we've reached the stage of our relationship where I needn't be conversing much, and can stick to what I do best. Keep sticking, too, witchie!
Don't know if it's your silver gear or what, but for a bit there I thought I was staring at the Moon... don't much get to see the Moon in my line of work.
Something's been going on out there, the others saying it's a proper nasty night! Makes no difference in my forge, but... sounds like you are really in for it, witchie.
Well everybody's all worked up tonight! I've no idea why. Mayhap some witchie stuff only you know about? 'Cause even my Automatons have been behaving bad... worse than usual I mean!

{#Emph}Say{#Prev}, where'd you get that silver armor you've got on? Much finer work than first I thought. Not too much coverage, mind, but you seem more the sort that likes to freely move about. Always a trade-off to be made!
So that's the Staff of Dusk, is it? Descura, that's her name! Forged who-only-knows-how-deep within the Earth under the watchful eye of Night... something like that.

Am I mistaken, witchie... or are you bearing Xinth the Black bloody Coat? {#Emph}Wearing {#Prev}it, I should say! Heard how it's put together but I've never seen it for myself! Let's see what it can do.
Welcome to the fine city of Ephyra, witchie! Most important thing to know is, whatever happens to you there, {#Emph}I {#Prev}cannot be held liable. I work weapons, not miracles...
Ain't you not supposed to be able to breathe up here or something? Well, what can you do but push on through, is what I say! Ain't always easy but we manage or we try.

...Don't know where all these Satyrs, Harpies, and whatnot are getting their supplies. Mayhap looting the ones you dealt with just the night before? Either way, looks like old-world Cyclopean design to me. It's solid work!

{#Emph}Oi! {#Prev}What are you doing on {#Emph}this {#Prev}side, you lose your way? Thought you had business in the Underworld, not here. Mayhap I'm just a bit out of the loop is all... you need this stuff or not?
I heard the latest, witchie, that you're headed for our mountain tippy-top! Just don't expect warm welcomes when you get here, as we are a... a bit preoccupied right now?
Don't know what's been with all the rumbling of late, but it ain't Poseidon, and it ain't my forge. Probably something bad! But, I ain't sweating it till I know what it is.

Ran into mighty Talos, didn't you? Big man all made of bronze. Swore up and down he'd be my best invention yet, but... still got a few kinks need sorting out. Don't bother going easy on him, got to take him apart anyhow...

I tried to make it so that Talos would begin to learn as he encountered different combat situations and the like, but... I ain't seen much evidence that's doing any good. He's not been too much of a pain has he?
Wonder what Chronos did to Tartarus? Was quite the architectural feat under your mum and dad! But the Titan hasn't got any taste. Probably turned everything to gold...

See all those Chronos ships trudging this way, witchie? Most of 'em already sunk before, however many times. They and their dead crews keep coming back to haunt us! Now {#Emph}that's {#Prev}some dedicated service, {#Emph}eh?

Know what I learned in all this, witchie? {#Emph}No time like the present. {#Prev}Whatever happened in the distant past ain't my fault! Might be my problem though! As for what happens in the future, {#Emph}ach{#Prev}, I'll handle it then. Well, back to work!
Hold on, that's Ygnium you've got! The Flames of the Crossroads Witch! What, has the student become the master or somesuch, or is she just getting you to do all the dirty work?

You seen the size of the bloody monster been clambering up our mountainside, witchie? I haven't, thankfully, but... hearing that he's pretty big in size! Typhon hisself! I scarce can keep a steady hand with him about!

Oi, where'd that great big monster out there go? The mountain's rumbling's all settled down and now my clanging's just about the worst of it. You got him then? {#Emph}Ach{#Prev}, I didn't even get to have a look.

What I {#Emph}really {#Prev}want to know is, how'd you blast old Typhon into smithereens? Don't have much here could've done something like {#Emph}that{#Prev}, least not without taking the summit too. You got to let me in on it sometime.

Wait... has Typhon been destroyed or no? Not seen much sign of monsters, which ain't known for subtlety. But then I heard my dad talking about how {#Emph}you've {#Prev}been dealing with their remnants here. Mayhap they're real small!
Time for more spelunking, {#Emph}eh{#Prev}, witchie? Going damn near to the bottom of the bloody earth! Must be good rocks and metals and such there. Your dad got all the hidden gems!

Feel any tremors, they are probably Uncle Poseidon shaking up the place. Though there {#Emph}are {#Prev}times it's me! When Earth herself gets angry with the state of things, I give 'er a good outlet to let off a little steam.

{#Emph}Oi{#Prev}, I take back {#Emph}everything {#Prev}I said about your weapon first we met. In my defense, ain't often I see workmanship superior to mine! Though, don't go telling anyone I said as much...

Wracked my brain about those fancy silver weapons of yours, trying to sort out who exactly could have made such things... or when? They're the Nocturnal Arms, ain't they? Meant only as a last resort! But here we are, I reckon.

I'll be the first to say one shouldn't judge by looks, but... I just didn't figure you to be so keen on proper weapon maintenance, 'cause yours are strong as hell! And making {#Emph}them {#Prev}shine makes {#Emph}me {#Prev}shine.

While back, your brother came to us for help, what's his name... {#Emph}Zagreus? {#Prev}I wasn't having it. This family's problems would disappear overnight if we could just stop getting in each other's business! Felt bad sitting it out, though...

You and Zagreus been getting on? Known my brother all my life... must be something that you're only just getting to know him now! Try not to fight too much. {#Emph}Heh{#Prev}, but then again, that's what brothers are for!
Reckon my dad'll be of help in all this! Lord Zeus, he loves to help! Especially hisself... lot on the line right now, and you don't get to be the king of Olympus being coy.
Don't sweat it, you'll be as good as new here in a bit.
Oi witchie, let me see about that hunk of metal you got there.
You still alive, witchie? Here, this ought to keep it that way.
Just clanking away as always, though let's do some clanking now on your behalf.
Reckon you're looking for another tune-up, no problem at all.
No charge per usual, I'll just throw it on tab and some point Dad'll pick it up.
So you got a bit of metal I could effortlessly bend to my will or something?
I just had the strongest urge to bang on solid metal for a bit.
Oi, you're about due for another servicing appointment on that thing.
You got a dangerous line of work, witchie. Though I can get you some protection here.
How's it going and the like, all good? All good, that's great, now here.
{#Emph}Eugh{#Prev}, it's been an awful lot of late! Don't sweat it, though. Always got room for you.
{#Emph}Ehh{#Prev}, think I got just the thing to help you with the killing-and-not-dying here, witchie.
You know, the more I work those weapons, the more intricacies I can find...
I don't normally just give away my services, but it ain't normally of late.
Say, what's that you got there, witchie, a nice weapon of some sort?
{#Emph}Ehh{#Prev}, fancy meeting you again and all, now let me get to work.
Only so much I can do when you're out and about with that walking stick, you know.
{#Emph}Ehh{#Prev}, it's that staff again... well, mayhap I can do something about the knots at least.
Fine couple of knives you got there, witchie. Though let's make 'em proper vicious here.
Hold up those flashy blades of yours for me and I'll have 'em sharper than ever.
{#Emph}Ahh{#Prev}, brought my favorite out to play, did you? Just needs a tune-up and you'll be all set.
Who needs witchery when you can go on brandishing an axe like that?
Bringing a couple flaming sticks to a fight? Well, whatever works, witchie.
{#Emph}Ehh{#Prev}, turns out torches ain't just for lighting your way! Let's see 'em here.
All sorts of silver I can work with in that skull of yours, so put 'er up!
{#Emph}Ohh{#Prev}, right sinister choice of weapon you got there, witchie.
Soon as I'm through, you go knock some sense into some wretches for me, would you?
Fine suit you got there, witchie! Though, reckon we could spice it up a bit!
Your suit seems in fine working order, though a tune-up couldn't hurt.
I always said a bit of evening work is good for you, witchie.
You work for the family, you're entitled to the family protection plan.
Oi, you got something from Daedalus already? Well I can work with that.
Come on up, the weather's fine! So I hear. Been in my forge a while now.
Apologies if my Automatons make any trouble for you whilst you're here.
I'm not the one out there taking hits. Least I can do is soften 'em for you.
Been keeping busy underground? I can relate better than anybody here.
You've been on a proper rampage, witchie! So let's see you keep it up.
How's things there in the Underworld, all right? Here they're not bad.
Oi {#Emph}there's {#Prev}my favorite Moonstone Axe! Go cleave something in two for me, witchie.
Using the classic staff tonight? The kind I make can't shoot, but... yours is giving me ideas.
Brought out those blades for yet another go! I really like the curvy one!
Never thought of using torches for a weapon, but you really make it work!
That skull is not exactly in my area of weapons expertise, but I can tell it works!
I always like it when you use Xinth the Black Coat. Makes everything go {#Emph}boom!
What, is he going to fit me for a suit of armor? {#Emph}In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message!

2.Text: Oi, you that new cousin of mine? They told me you needed a weapon or something. {#Emph}Ach{#Prev}, you already got one! Right lousy one, can spot {#Emph}that {#Prev}piss-poor workmanship from here. Though, I {#Emph}could {#Prev}tune it up...

1.Text: ...You wouldn't know it, witchie, but I'm mad this evening. Nothing you did, mind! Fortunately, when I'm mad, I do good work. My {#Emph}best {#Prev}damn work if I say so myself...
Can't guarantee a weapon worthy of the gods is going to be enough for you to see this through. But I {#Emph}can {#Prev}guarantee you're getting the very best.
You look like you've been beaten like a chunk of ore! Just keep it together long enough to appreciate my handiwork.
{#Emph}Eugh{#Prev}, you're in shambles there, witchie. Mayhap this'll be too little too late! Could've come in handy earlier.
Well, you look plain awful right now, and that's coming from {#Emph}me! {#Prev}Though hey, you get a free weapon service with the, {#Emph}erm... {#Prev}unwelcome remark.
So you took some hits along the way, so what? You're an extension of your weapon, witchie! And a decent one can take a lot of punishment.

I can appreciate an armament of damn near any shape or size, but... ones shaped like that Moonstone Axe you got might be my favorite were I forced to choose at weaponpoint. Let's see what you can do with it, witchie!

Everybody here is going off about the Fates deciding to show up unceremonious, to which I say: so what? Nobody knows what they're doing, {#Emph}them {#Prev}least of all. {#Emph}Ach{#Prev}, mayhap I'm just jealous they'll be taking time off work...

Don't know what's such a big a deal with the Three Fates going on about a distant time. You're telling me that in the span of, I don't know, twenty-something mortal generations, things might change? {#Emph}Ach {#Prev}you don't say!
You bloody did it, then? Whatever {#Emph}it {#Prev}is, everybody here has got their own idea, but... I reckon Typhon's gone and Chronos is touched in the head, so... all in all, not bad.
Got to keep on climbing up here, I'm to understand? Bit of {#Emph}insurance {#Prev}against any other Typhon-like events... and you and Chronos and the lot of us are gonna see to that? Well all right!

So Grandpa Chronos keeps on lending us a hand! To deal with what he did to us, but still! I reckoned he'd be back to his old self by now, but... mayhap you scrambled him enough that it'll stick. {#Emph}Heh... {#Prev}think you could do that to my mum?
Thought I was due to catch a break once all the fighting and whatnot had simmered down, but no! The fighting must go on, which come to think is no surprise, I mean, it's us! We find a way!
Had an opening come up in my schedule, so I figured why not get your gear back to better-than-new condition right from the start?
Oi, wanted to catch you right on your way out! Got a special this evening: free tune-ups for secret silver weapons, if you got one there?
Fine evening to you, witchie! My work ain't quick, but sometimes {#Emph}I {#Prev}can be. And here I thought, why don't I join her from the get-go, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Can't hurt!
Where do you think you're off to, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Best not head out against {#Emph}impossible {#Prev}odds whilst unprepared, so here! Let's get you suited up right quick.

Off to pay us all a visit then, or try? Reckon you're liable to get into a {#Emph}tussle {#Prev}or two on the way, but... I can offer a {#Emph}complete {#Prev}protection plan against that sort of thing!
It's good to have you back up top, witchie, because things on the mountain are a little touchy still. Or are we keeping it that way on purpose? Either way, doesn't bother me.

Off to tell your mum and dad the latest after paying us a visit here? Well, may you clobber anybody in your warpath, witchie! 'Specially if it's some other bad Chronos or whatever it is you're doing down there now.
{#Emph}Ohh, there {#Prev}you are! We'd lost you for a bit! Must have gone so deep, we couldn't spy on you no more. Well, you've still got your arms and legs! Must have turned out all right.

Am I to understand you gave a certain {#Emph}Titan {#Prev}a right thorough walloping of late? Mayhap {#Emph}I {#Prev}helped in my own way? Not like you took down Chronos with your bare hands, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Point is, {#Emph}good job{#Prev}, witchie!
All right, we're squared away for now, and break time's over. Back to work!
That's what I like to call {#Emph}hammering out the details{#Prev}. Leave 'em to me next time.
{#Emph}Eh! {#Prev}Fine, consider me appeased. But don't incur my wrath again lest I— I don't even know.
Was as close as I am liable to get to blowing up. Still working at it, mind!
Now that you've seen some samples of my work, perhaps you'd like some for yourself?
Some work you did! Though, looks like you could use some patching up.
{#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, no use staying mad over nothing! Wasn't all that mad, mind.
Been working on my anger issues. Can't blow my top like some of the others here...
All right, I'd say we're settled up! We can continue bickering another time.
{#Emph}Hrm{#Prev}, that there was not the most productive thing I did all day, but {#Emph}eh... this {#Prev}ought to make up.
Congratulations, witchie, you survived. And here is what you won.
Don't take these fights too personal, it happens up here all the bloody time.
All right, I count you settled up after all that. Time to get back to work!
Don't let anybody know, but... I held off back there. 'Cause I ain't really mad.
Time for a tune-up.

2.Text: From the forge.

1.Text: All right then!

2.Text: That I can do.

HephaestusRejection01.Text: Whoever messes with me, they get pounded flat. No exceptions! Not even for {#Emph}you.

HephaestusRejection02.Text: I don't stick up for myself, I'll never hear the end of it. So best ready for the sparks to fly a bit.

HephaestusRejection03.Text: {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, much rather keep on hammering this metal over here, but... I can switch over to {#Emph}you {#Prev}instead.

HephaestusRejection04.Text: Push me around, I'm liable to push right back. And I push harder than you might expect...

HephaestusRejection05.Text: Not going to blow my top... but neither will I take this lying down. Family requirements!

HephaestusRejection06.Text: You brought this on yourself, witchie! And by {#Emph}this{#Prev}, I mean my favorite hammer here.

HephaestusRejection07.Text: {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, don't care for having to retaliate like this, but... it's all part of the deal, you understand.

1.Text: No denying Aphrodite was the fairer choice, but still! Can't let this go unchecked.

HephaestusRejection09.Text: You want to see my handiwork, then {#Emph}fine! {#Prev}Might get a wee bit noisy, though.

HephaestusRejection10.Text: Next I offer you protection, witchie? You'd be wise to take me up on it.

1.Text: You'd go warring with my brother over me? Where do you think he gets his gear?
I'd pick Aphrodite too but... she's expecting me to fight for her, you understand.
My dad's not used to anybody standing up to him, but we can get him there.
Mayhap I'll make me mum real proud if I act spiteful without proper cause!
Next time, make Ares mad not me. He's the one wants an excuse to fight!
It is I.

2.Text: Behold your Queen.

1.Text: We're not taking any chances, girl. For instance, we are {#Emph}not {#Prev}above having our blessings transported like common parcels, if in so doing, we ensure your victory and ours.
Admit it, girl! You would have taken any sort of blessing here and now, whether from {#Emph}me {#Prev}or any of my kin. Well as the Fates would have it, you're getting the very best.
To think that the blessings of the Queen of Olympus could be fetched from some unassuming sack! Whatever damage this mountain has sustained, our pride has suffered worse.
We've a long-standing partnership with your good boatman there. I bring mortals into being and marry them off after a bit, he takes them yonder to your realm! Or used to, anyway.
Wealth cannot be measured in mere coin! The very idea is absurd; yet, there you are, paying for goods and services as though Chronos has already prevailed!
We cannot always reach you in those depths, though your boatman seems to have no trouble at all. Keeps to himself, fends for himself... I quite like him!
At least this was a shorter delivery for your trusted boatman, compared with having to drag our Boons all the way into the Underworld. Although, he probably prefers it there...
You may be a princess; but remember, {#Emph}I {#Prev}am the Queen.

2.Text: In my position, a certain strictness is required I'm afraid.

3.Text: We Olympians are famous for our wrath; we have to be.

4.Text: I took little pleasure in this, girl. Merely a trace, at best.

1.Text: Even Titans and gods are quite vulnerable creatures, deep down. For we are all driven by a most-delicate instrument, as liable to stir our spirits or drive us to despair, as my dear Aphrodite knows full well.

2.Text: Come now, my Queen! The heart's the strongest part we've got and tougher than it seems! We've withstood a bit upon this mountaintop, but we can take much more. Especially when our hearts {#Emph}all {#Prev}beat as one!

1.Text: I fear for the younger generation. What can you possibly achieve when you're born with our worst qualities and not merely our best? Take good Apollo here... just like his father.

2.Text: Now, Stepmother, don't all we gods aspire to your husband's excellence? I do appreciate the kind comparison! My fair cousin likewise surely has her father's finest traits!

1.Text: At least Lord Ares is back to where it's {#Emph}easier {#Prev}for me to keep an {#Emph}eye {#Prev}on him. Come, my son, let's make ourselves somewhat presentable? For the benefit of my niece there.

2.Text: It shall be as you wish, O Queen. I'm honored that you sought me out, and trust our kin shall be most grateful to you in turn, as the vessel of the sum of our wrath.

1.Text: Much as your father was custodian of all the dead, so are we responsible for the rest of the world! The hour has grown dark, yes, but... we have the power to {#Emph}restore. {#Prev}Thanks be to my good sister Demeter...

2.Text: The time for restoration always comes as does the spring. But we're amidst a long winter, without an end in sight. We need concern ourselves with naught else, O Queen.

1.Text: I know full well we cannot stand on ceremony whilst our entire way of life is under threat! Yet surely my dear son Hephaestus here need not be so {#Emph}uncouth {#Prev}at every opportunity?

2.Text: Not like you ever taught me proper manners, Mum. Fortunately, I did learn a couple things even without having a role model like you or Dad around to set me straight! Just {#Emph}watch{#Prev}. And witchie, too!

1.Text: Why, {#Emph}this {#Prev}is a remarkable development, my dear! Hephaestus has emerged, however briefly from his forge. I asked my son to greet his cousin properly, but didn't think he would.

2.Text: {#Emph}Oh {#Prev}come on, Mum, you didn't think I'd end up doing much of anything. I know my best ain't always good enough, but then again, whose is? Now, can I get back to my work?

1.Text: We goddesses can be too proud to beg for aid! I'd never stoop to it myself. Why bother, when my hard-headed sister Hestia shall insist on intervening, anyway? And at this very moment {#Emph}whilst I speak!

2.Text: Because, respectfully, you just don't know what's {#Emph}good {#Prev}for you, O Queen! Sometimes it's ones can't bring themselves to ask for help that need it {#Emph}most! {#Prev}Now why don't we set a {#Emph}proper {#Prev}example for the latest unceremonious addition to our family?

1.Text: A shame you never knew your father, girl... but at least now you know his good brother Poseidon, here! Imagine this one, but without the foolish grin, nor the inappropriate remarks, with frankly better hair, in finer physical form.

2.Text: {#Emph}Ah, hahaha! {#Prev}See how strong a family we are, my niece?! For even in the face of such catastrophe as we have all endured, the Queen herself is able to make such humorous remarks! At my expense. But {#Emph}still!

1.Text: {#Emph}Ah! {#Prev}Look, my dear! It's my beloved husband. The distinguished {#Emph}King of the Olympians{#Prev}, who shall lead us all out of this mess. How goes it, Son of Chronos, any news?

2.Text: Oh, {#Emph}hahaha! {#Prev}Come now, Hera dear, for all your jesting with me, it can send the wrong impression to one unaccustomed to your dry and clever wit! You see that, Melinoë? Humor is the bond that makes a marriage strong!

1.Text: Our family's unity does not come cheap. We all must work together to ensure the bonds connecting us don't fray, or split entirely as was the case with Chronos. My Lord Husband knows this better than anyone, don't you, Zeus?

2.Text: You're quite right, Dear, that marriage can most certainly begin to feel like work! It was so easy for us in the early days, but our responsibilities have grown since, haven't they?

1.Text: The Crest of the Queen...
I love a messy break-up!

2.Text: Behold the Queen's wrath!

3.Text: They'll wish they were never born!

1.Text: You wish to toy with {#Emph}me, girl?

2.Text: We have a clever one in our midst!

1.Text: The Queen...?

2.Text: Queen Hera...!

1.Text: That so-called {#Emph}Queen?!

2.Text: My son's beloved wife?

1.Text: You truly needn't have, Your Majesty.
Queen Hera, out of all the matters you could be attending to, you've chosen to aid me. I am honored, and would honor you in kind.

2.Text: Is there a wedding date that I should know about or are you merely being generous with me? In any case, when I am offered to, there's always a catch. So, here!

1.Text: Great Queen of Olympus! I am humbled to have earned your favor, and will do everything I can to honor you!

2.Text: Unbound by wedlock yet you praise me thus? I must say you are full of surprises, my dear. Or potentially just very ignorant. Or both!

1.Text: This golden Nectar is nothing in comparison to your splendor, Queen Hera; but it's the very best we have where I am from. To your eternal beauty, grace, and wisdom!

2.Text: You needn't be a flatterer, you know? I aid you not from love but from necessity. If there's a lesson I can impart, it's that you ought to keep your guard up at all times.

1.Text: To the Queen of Olympus! Long may you reign, and may that reign be one of great prosperity and peace, both for your devoted family and subjects, and for you!

2.Text: Go on, girl. We each know I'm not really your Queen. You're not even an Olympian, so why don't you drop the act? Or if it's not an act, wise up. This is a complicated world.

1.Text: Queen Hera, though these exchanges between us must necessarily be brief, I'm grateful for each moment you can spare. I know your family needs you, and Olympus needs you... and your devotion to each is abundantly clear.

2.Text: Well, my dear, if you find no future to be had in your witchcraft, you could always take up theatrics! For I very nearly believed your every word. Honesty is not our family's trade, but! I commend your effort anyhow.

1.Text: You may not trust me at my word, O Queen; but with this offering of Nectar you shall find I bear no falsehoods or duplicitous intent. You're not just royalty to me... you're my Great Aunt. And as glorious as I could have imagined.

2.Text: You're really serious, aren't you? Look, girl. You don't seem to understand what it's like on this mountain. There is no margin for error here; no room to slip! Although perhaps you've had a taste of that sort of {#Emph}pressure {#Prev}for yourself...

1.Text: Thank you for holding our family together through the most trying of times, Queen Hera! And for having faith in me to make a difference. May the sweetness of this Ambrosia start to dull the memory of our bitter struggles.

2.Text: That's very kind of you, my dear. But my memory is {#Emph}long {#Prev}and {#Emph}sharp{#Prev}, and I'd not let it dull on purpose or otherwise. Our memories embolden us, and keep us from repeating our mistakes. Thank the Fates I was not mistaken about you.

1.Text: The goddess of love, always one step ahead of me. How many mortals do you suppose would seek me out to bless their wedding vows, had Aphrodite not already worked her {#Emph}charms {#Prev}on them? It seems our strengths go hand in hand.
Golden Apollo already offered you his aid, has he now? Always so eager to please. I find his constant doting bothersome... but doubtless you're more tolerant than I.
Most all of us have a taste for violence, girl, but my son Ares takes it to a {#Emph}quite {#Prev}uncomfortable extreme. He may be useful in such times, but we mustn't let him get too excited.

We've sent young Artemis near to the border of your realm and ours. We require some additional awareness there, and you likely could benefit from a bit of covering fire. Sometimes I miss wielding a bow myself...

We've wise Athena holding back the front but probably could use a score of others {#Emph}equally {#Prev}as capable. She has the Titan's raiders running scared, but... even she can't always stop them all.

You seem adept at keeping distance from your enemies. I once excelled at this myself, although I favored an arrow through the heart over magick, which I found rather unreliable. But, whatever works for you!
Oh, the blessings that my kin and I bestow, why... they're a bit like children, I suppose. You don't always get the kind you want, but if you're clever, you can make them work!

I always wanted a little girl, you know? But I got Ares. Hephaestus. {#Emph}Eugh! {#Prev}Zeus' girls Athena and Artemis stay well afield of me, and Aphrodite, oh, she does what she wants. Some family we are.
Our great big family, why, we would have been just a small fraction of the size, if not for my husband's escapades! So many delightful children in my life as a result.

Ever think of having children of your own, my dear? If so, perhaps you're thinking twice after all {#Emph}this. {#Prev}But we shall need another generation soon enough! And it may as well come from good stock.

Remember, girl, this world is ours by right. The Fates themselves decided it! Now Chronos seeks to overthrow our reign? He already had his opportunity to rule. There is no going back to how things were.
The Titan Chronos is no father of mine. But your father sprang from him, as did my husband, and Poseidon as well. So, now we're all tied up in this little family affair!
Would that I could put another arrow in between the eyes of Chronos again myself, but alas, you're closer and I'm stuck. Kill him for me, would you?
This matter with Chronos, it may seem unconscionable that a parent could resent their own children. But let me tell you, girl, there are moments when I {#Emph}almost {#Prev}sympathize.

I always knew Chronos would return. Zeus kept saying I was fearful over nothing! We buried the old wretch in the depths of Tartarus, after all. But he's a deathless Titan. {#Emph}Time{#Prev}, it seems, slipped through our fingers...

Do find a mate who pays you proper compliments, girl! My Lord Husband, why, he calls me {#Emph}ox-eyed Lady Hera {#Prev}now and then! Says I've the big, beautiful eyes of a large {#Emph}bovine{#Prev}, ever the romantic that he is!

I never used to wear the same gown for two successive nights, let alone this long. But now we've no such time for pageantry. I miss those outfits, shimmering like stars! {#Emph}White-armed Hera {#Prev}I was, ever since my wedding day...
You're a witch. You must dabble in curses, yes? I've done a few of my own... one for this Nymph who talked too much, others for more-unspeakable acts. We must assert ourselves.
Cold vengeance... I can feel it from afar. I suppose my sister Demeter has more at stake in this than anybody on this mountaintop. Our enemies shall rue having crossed her.

The other night, given the opportunity, you sided with my kin, forgoing my Boon when I first generously offered it. Whilst that little scuffle is behind us, I do {#Emph}not {#Prev}appreciate any such slights. I trust I've made myself quite clear?
Expect no aid from Dionysus, who must be in a stupor somewhere, unless your idea of aid lies at the bottom of a drinking-cup. Though, come to think, that may not be the worst idea of late...
No surprise that Strife Incarnate recently decided to show up, as she is wont to do. Eris made good sport of us before! Must think we're fools and easy prey. You'll correct her, yes?

One thing I've learned, my dear, is that {#Emph}forever {#Prev}is a very long time. It seems to me that nothing {#Emph}truly {#Prev}lasts forever anymore. Perhaps that is why we find ourselves in this particular predicament.

This is hardly the first time I've been pressed to intervene on {#Emph}your {#Prev}side of the family's behalf. I've stood my ground! We cannot keep getting involved in each other's affairs. Yet, if you've come to our defense, you're owed an exception...

You've seen how we don't always get along, but once you've lived with this lot long enough, you'll be right there with us. Tolerance becomes a practiced skill! But we do love each other, by and large...

The Fates are gone, then, yes? According to Hermes? Quite the unfortunate turn of events if true. Well, if Chronos is bent on vengeance, it only makes sense that he would take it out on {#Emph}them{#Prev}, not just on {#Emph}us.

I'm to believe that Chronos {#Emph}truly doesn't {#Prev}know where he left the Three Fates? The {#Emph}weavers of destiny {#Prev}themselves, misplaced and forgotten like some {#Emph}trinkets! {#Prev}They're probably {#Emph}enjoying {#Prev}being rid of all of us.

You've seen the Mourning Fields within your Underworld, yes? A solid portion of the residents there are due to failed marriages... most typically their own. I bless each matrimony that I can, but it can only do so much.

{#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, your poor father. You must have been the jewel in his eye, only to have been ripped away! He would have been so very proud. Well, perhaps not {#Emph}proud{#Prev}, as such. He was never big on taking pride in anything, now that I think on it. {#Emph}I'm {#Prev}proud of you, at least!

The Witch of the Crossroads evidently raised you well! The younger generation here, they lack in character, and their manners oft leave {#Emph}much {#Prev}to be desired. Almost as though {#Emph}my {#Prev}generation did not set the best example!

{#Emph}Augh{#Prev}, at least Hephaestus is {#Emph}attempting {#Prev}to be of use! You'll have to excuse my sheltered son, girl. He'd much prefer to clang ceaselessly upon his forge than to be a part of polite society.

My soft-spoken son Hephaestus thinks I can be rather {#Emph}too unkind. {#Prev}Perhaps he's right! What, you think my mother showered {#Emph}me {#Prev}with love? Neither {#Emph}you {#Prev}yours. This is a harsh world, girl. No one asks to be born into it.

Word reached me you've encountered mighty Heracles! Big, thick-headed fellow? You're not to aid him in his labors, do you understand? He's in the middle of what we Olympians like to call a {#Emph}journey of self-discovery.

That Heracles is Zeus' lad, you know. {#Emph}Glory of Hera! {#Prev}I should be honored. He's just another mouth for me to feed, and one with quite an appetite, at that. But, I'll keep him busy, sure! We need all the help we can get.

You'd tell us if Heracles wasn't living up to expectations, yes? Confidentially, we're thinking once things finally settle down, we may invite him to join us on a more-permanent basis. He's labored enough, and we could use the muscle.

Where is that {#Emph}Hermes {#Prev}when you need him, have you seen him lately, girl? Always {#Emph}flitting {#Prev}about, impossible to pin down. {#Emph}Eugh. {#Prev}What news could there be to deliver at a time like {#Emph}this?
I'm pleased to see that you're agreeable with Hestia, my dear. Her temper and my own don't often mesh, but I respect her wisdom, and her power to simply burn everything down if and when necessary.

You always were one of the best hopes that we had in this, my dear. But frankly, I had little faith we would prevail, {#Emph}with {#Prev}you or without. So for this once, I'm pleased to have been wrong, and shall not soon forget all that you've done.

My sisters Demeter and Hestia and I, our father was the Titan called Hyperion. {#Emph}Father {#Prev}by technicality at least. You don't hear much about {#Emph}him {#Prev}anymore! We should have dealt with Chronos just the same back when we had the chance.
Why, if it isn't my Iridescent Fan, illuminated even in the night! The easier with which to spot you wheresoever you may be. Should you require my immediate assistance, merely wave it about a bit.
That Iridescent Fan I offered you has clearly been of more than decorative use! I had a feeling that you'd take to it, my dear. Never hesitate to give it a shake if you need me.

That last resort, which we would have used against Typhon, had you not found more of a targeted solution... merely something Hephaestus has been working on, halfheartedly. Would have cost my son his favored forge, and {#Emph}more!

I realize this may seem odd coming from me, my dear, but from one goddess to another: Do not rush into marriage! As much as it may seem a wondrous idea. Consider my example; and I'm the blasted goddess of marriage, herself!
{#Emph}Ah! {#Prev}There you are {#Emph}again{#Prev}, my dear! Pity to have only met in circumstances such as these. Yet families all go through their ups and downs, yes? Let me help you help us all.
To level with you, girl, I don't know that you've got what it takes to thwart the Titan. But, what choice do we have at this point? I'm willing to give you the benefit of the doubt.

We had an obligation to your father here. Each mortal death adds to the population of the Underworld, after all! I tried to do my blasted part to curb the flow a bit. Have you any idea how onerous it is for mortals to give birth?

If ever you wondered whence came all the {#Emph}wretches {#Prev}in your Underworld, there are such mortals who see it as {#Emph}our {#Prev}responsibility to protect {#Emph}them! {#Prev}Can you believe it?

I hardly blame them but {#Emph}some {#Prev}mortals have grown skeptical about our governance. They have this newfangled idea of {#Emph}luck... {#Prev}strokes of fortune from thin air! Sheer {#Emph}mindless {#Prev}happenstance, not the work of gods or the Three Fates.

Oh, mortalkind must take us for a pack of bickering fools, though they'd never admit it. We shall have to save face with them somehow. I'll ask that Demeter ensure more times of plenty are to come, and such.

{#Emph}Eugh{#Prev}, I can barely reach you as it is within that murk, and you seem even farther away now. The very outskirts of your father's realm, is it? That's... not the customary path into the Underworld....

Traveling this way {#Emph}again{#Prev}, are you, my dear? Doubtless to put the nonsensical theories of your Titan grandfather to the test! If you detect even a whiff of lies, do tell. Even if we're to be merciful, we still mustn't be fools.

You've seen the state our poor mountain is in. The embarrassing inventions of Hephaestus run as rampant as our enemies! Some of us remain cooped up in the Palace of Zeus away from it all. Quite lovely here at least!

Something about this night feels very odd; and in my experience, such premonitions are {#Emph}never {#Prev}to be ignored. Perhaps the strange forces at work are merely due to your invocations! Just... do be careful, girl.
I know something is going on tonight, but cannot say exactly what. Perhaps it's that Witch of the Crossroads, conjuring to our collective benefit. Or your own handiwork?

Pleased to have finally met in a more-proper way, my dear! You bought this mountain of ours a bit of extra time, so we are bolstering our defenses as best we can... thus I'm beseeching you to hurry back!

{#Emph}Tsk{#Prev}, you never even got to see the Palace proper, my dear. It's not presentable anyhow. Perhaps by the time your father's House is back in order, ours shall be as well! I quite insist you visit at that point.

You know the Twilight Curse, oh I can tell. The power to change a form into another! A favorite of mine, and one small step removed from shapeshifting oneself. The possibilities are limitless, really.
Confronted Polyphemus, have you, then? That is the sort of {#Emph}help {#Prev}Chronos employs. A hollow fool! But strong, admittedly. No sneaking past {#Emph}him{#Prev}, I'm afraid. We've tried....
Had I but known that stout Poseidon went out of his way for you earlier, I would have got here even sooner. The sea is unreliable, whilst my bond is forever. Figuratively, at least!

First Chronos and now Prometheus are back to haunt us, all because we failed to get rid of them back when we had a chance. Who next, I wonder? You witches really need to come up with a means to dispense with immortals for good.

My Lord Husband and Prometheus are not on, shall we say, the best of terms. And that Titan has made clear what he thinks of us goddesses and gods. Yet, now we're tolerating him, to clean the mess he helped create? Absurd...

Aphrodite has quite gleefully informed me that {#Emph}you {#Prev}and certain friends of yours have grown quite close. Well if one thing leads to another and you decide to make a serious commitment, I should be {#Emph}only {#Prev}too pleased to oblige!

A fine girl such as yourself must have suitors! Just don't be quick to wed if you can help it, yes? Mortals like to tie themselves down for the remainders of their lives but often barely manage it. And {#Emph}their {#Prev}lifetimes are nothing!
We might not care for it but there's a certain power to being underestimated constantly. Right, girl? Let them think what they want; my blessings aren't merely for couples about to tie the knot.

My husband Zeus and I have {#Emph}spirited {#Prev}debates regarding how you may ensure our victory. He is too proud to seek your help here on our mountaintop, whilst I would welcome it with open arms, so... come along!

Well, this {#Emph}has {#Prev}been a real journey, hasn't it, my dear? I may be briefer with you hence, as other matters increasingly demand my attention. Though, you'll have my blessings for as long as you require.

You know, I saw a flicker in the sky before, as though the moonlight shifted for a moment. But now it's like that light is shining from {#Emph}you. {#Prev}You drew Selene down! She would not answer such a call from most.
This night has left me feeling ill-at-ease, for many of our enemies are growing rather bold. Mortals experience fear when their lives are at risk, but this cannot be {#Emph}that!

That fearsome feeling in the air, so then it {#Emph}is {#Prev}your doing, isn't it, girl? I fail to see how riling up our enemies shall do us {#Emph}any {#Prev}good. Now you go deal with them at once!
{#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, you know Night Bloom, of course. A means to raise the dead for a little while. Easier than raising live children, honestly... and significantly quicker, too.

Welcome, my dear, to our world's surface! First time? It's a vast place! All sorts of different climates, mortal cultures, and the like. So don't let your first impression shake your faith; it isn't always such a disaster!

Mortals complained their city of Ephyra was forsaken by the gods, yet here we are! Ungrateful wretches. Not had many weddings of late. Not many funerals either... though, lots of death, destruction, and the like!

There are many potent reagents growing on the surface here, if you know where to look! Mere roots and flowers to the untrained eye, but in your hands, or better, in your cauldron? They'll have you working magick like never before.
They said you weren't cut out for being aboveground! Some Underworld curse holding you back... I'd not believed the hearsay for a moment, and sure enough. Perhaps they merely fear your potential.

There was a recent rumbling about Olympus, which caused us some concern. A {#Emph}real {#Prev}rumbling, I mean! Even Poseidon was surprised at all the shaking. What, does Chronos mean to topple the entire mountain?
{#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, good girl, to have turned your attention to the Underworld at last! It's so humiliating all that's happened to us here. Least we can do is clean up after ourselves.
Such a dreadful fleet that sails our way... when last I witnessed one of such magnitude, the ships were sailing in my honor, rather than against my home.

It's blasted Typhon, girl! The worst monstrosity you can imagine. Chronos up and decided to wake him from his deathly slumber, and pointed him towards {#Emph}us! {#Prev}So what if we cannot die? Things can still be very bad for us...

You truly rid us of that {#Emph}blasted {#Prev}Typhon. Never have we faced such an overwhelming threat, and {#Emph}all {#Prev}we could do was keep him at bay! Now we have the upper hand again because of {#Emph}you{#Prev}, my dear.

Such power you possess, my dear... whatever it is you did to Typhon, that's a secret to be guarded well. We could keep it for you! Our vaults have never {#Emph}once {#Prev}been breached. Think on it, yes?
Old Typhon suffered a bit of a spill last night but already is beginning to stir, Hermes reports. His target clearly is our summit... if only he were as easy to thwart as to predict.

Headed down to check on your mother and father, my dear? The House of Hades probably could use your touch. If only my {#Emph}own {#Prev}children would be so considerate. Though, I suppose they are still aiding you...
I know something of witchcraft myself, girl. A subtle art, and therein lies its strength. Easy to disbelieve, or to dismiss as mere coincidence. But true power need not assert itself.

{#Emph}Ah! {#Prev}I see that my distinguished husband has already been in touch. Well, just in case he doesn't make the sparks fly in {#Emph}quite {#Prev}the manner you expect, I have something for you of my own.
Again, Lord Zeus has reached you first, has he? {#Emph}Heh. {#Prev}The noble Son of Chronos and his lightning speed! You can't imagine just how quickly he flees from {#Emph}me{#Prev}, sometimes.

For all his foibles, my husband makes a dangerous adversary. Why else do you think we've ruled for however many aeons it's been? Zeus doubtless has his enemies, but few are brave or misguided enough to let on.

Lord Zeus and I, we've known each other for a time. A regular old married couple we are! And yet such awful things are often said of us. I try to brush it off! No couple is beyond reproach; certainly, not one that's survived as long as we.
A blessing for {#Emph}you{#Prev}, and a curse for our enemies, my dear.
How odd that this conflict tearing us apart is bringing us closer together, {#Emph}hm?
Chronos is an old fool whose time has long since passed.
Surely one amongst my blessings ought to suit you well?
Show no weakness, show no mercy, girl.
Just look at us, girl! Our family's a mess, but we're making it work.
Hera's here for you, girl; and soon, all your enemies shall wish that they were never born.
Your Great Aunt's back, my dear, so let's have ourselves an interesting night.
Nothing like jointly annihilating our enemies to bring the family closer together, {#Emph}hm?
Surprise, surprise, you're once again where I expected you to be.
All right, girl, let's just have a look at you and see what we can do.
Perhaps our family deserves all this, though we'll keep fighting back against it nonetheless.
To think all we needed was a perilous existential threat to unite this family, for once!
Chin up, girl! Things could probably end up much worse than they are now.
Our family may be cursed by the Fates themselves, but we do know how to fight.
We've so many enemies, I cannot curse them all! Though I {#Emph}can {#Prev}bless {#Emph}you.
Care for a little power over life itself? Or death. I've got that, too.
I confess I'm beginning to enjoy these little outings that we share.
Raised in the Underworld, yet you've more poise and grace than the lot of them up here.
More and more it seems you're just about the only one I can depend on lately, girl.
I'm in a bit of a foul mood right now, so quickly choose, and go.
This little tradition of ours has become something I look forward to, dear girl.
The Fates denied me any daughters, but at least they brought me you, my dear.
Life has its wretched spans every so often, so the better times stand out.
We on Olympus take our vengeance very personally, girl.
Would that some others that I knew had even but a shred of your commitment.
It simply is our lot to have to shoulder more than our fair share of any burden, girl.
You've no idea how long it's been since I've depended upon anybody of our line.
Our enemy has scorned us and we'll make him rue the very day, won't we?
I've enough power vested in me that I'm pleased to spare you some of it for now.
You have more royal bearing than I would have thought...
Soon this whole matter shall be put to bed, but till then, we persevere.
For all your patience and commitment, I'd say you're ready to be wed!
Our mountain's still an utter mess, if you don't mind having to clean up a bit.
The Palace necessarily remains off limits, though you're free to make the trip.
We still cannot get to your Underworld's depths, if you could keep an eye on things?
Do go make certain your lord father and dear mother still are carrying on well.
Let us stay vigilant as we rebuild, lest we make the same missteps.
For all the family squabbles that we have, we mustn't let them get like this again.
Go on then, girl, and make all our enemies rue the day they were born.
The family stands united in our cause... {#Emph}In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message!{#Prev}

2.Text: Pleased to make your acquaintance finally, my dear! Already had enough of the surface, yes? {#Emph}Heh{#Prev}, well I promised the family that once you demonstrated your resolve to us, I'd take you under my wing. And I {#Emph}always {#Prev}keep my vows.

1.Text: The family stands united in our cause... {#Emph}In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message!

2.Text: Pleased to make your acquaintance finally, my dear! Welcome to our world's surface, such as it is. I promised the family that once you demonstrated your resolve to us, then I'd take you under my wing... and, I {#Emph}always {#Prev}keep my vows.

1.Text: The family stands united in our cause... {#Emph}In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message!{#Prev}

2.Text: {#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, there she is! Already had enough of the surface, yes? {#Emph}Heh{#Prev}, well I promised the family that once you demonstrated your resolve to us, I'd take you under my wing. And I {#Emph}always {#Prev}keep my vows.

1.Text: The family stands united in our cause... {#Emph}In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message!

2.Text: {#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, there you are, my dear! Welcome to our world's surface, such as it is. I promised the family that once you demonstrated your resolve to us, then I'd take you under my wing... and, I {#Emph}always {#Prev}keep my vows.

1.Text: How about we break ourselves out of this rut, girl, so here! This is the best I've got for you for now. Do make the most of it?
My mood darkens again, my dear, although it makes me rather generous, I think. Here, then! The finest of my blessings. Go on, and tie some knots!
{#Emph}Oh! {#Prev}You're a frightful mess, if you'll forgive my saying, girl! I can't help you when you're practically dead! At least, not very much.
What happened to all your lifeblood? That's precious stuff! Yet you've gone spilling it about, then have the {#Emph}nerve {#Prev}to thus present yourself to me.
However much you've trained, it evidently was not {#Emph}nearly {#Prev}enough, if you've {#Emph}already {#Prev}taken such a {#Emph}beating {#Prev}before I can even begin to protect you!
Not having a good night...? Your injuries will heal eventually, my dear. But, I can't make any promises about your pride.

The Fates are found! Such a relief our destinies are safely back in their hands. I was beginning to fear the course of our futures would forever be {#Emph}ours {#Prev}to decide. Perhaps once we're older, and more responsible.

A new age is to dawn soon enough, is {#Emph}that {#Prev}it? That much, the Three Fates guarantee, but otherwise we can do as we please! Well, fine. If mortals think they can get on without {#Emph}our {#Prev}intervention, I should like to see them try!

How fare you in your task of late, my dear? Much better than we fare up here, I hope. Oh, all of us are fine, except... being besieged does mean we're stuck in closer quarters than I'd like. There's not a moment's peace!

Take it from me, my dear, don't listen to your heart. I know it's difficult, seeing as the blasted thing tends to be very loud. But if you heed it, it'll lead you straight to your mistakes more often than not.

My word, girl. To have delivered a groveling, impotent Chronos right into our hands, after having utterly destroyed Typhon... one astonishing feat after another, even for a goddess of your pedigree. How can we ever repay you?

I don't see {#Emph}why {#Prev}you keep heading this way, when it's {#Emph}your {#Prev}Underworld that seems to need more help. The mountain's {#Emph}fine! {#Prev}Well mostly. Other than these remnant forces of the Titan ruffling our feathers still...
Each night presents to us a new beginning, isn't that so, my dear? And on {#Emph}this {#Prev}night, {#Emph}I {#Prev}shall accompany you from the very start... until the bitter end.

Your Underworld has long since fallen, but our Olympus yet stands; you're wise to head this way, where you can make a {#Emph}real {#Prev}difference, here and now. As {#Emph}I {#Prev}shall momentarily!
A single, capable combatant striking our enemies from their exposed flanks may be {#Emph}just {#Prev}what we require to drive them back. Looks like {#Emph}you're {#Prev}up for the job tonight!
Your descent into the Underworld has only begun, but I would join you from the very first steps. I'd far prefer it to all my other obligations put together, let me tell you!
You came closer than ever to our mountaintop! I hoped, perhaps, that we could meet at last, but... we've more pressing matters to attend to now, the both of us.
We saw reports suggesting that you made it to the lowest depths! I thought perhaps you had prevailed... though, not yet, it seems. A sign of progress, nonetheless! Press on.

Word here is you somehow got the old wretch last night! Splendid if so. You'd think {#Emph}Time itself {#Prev}would know when to get out of the younger generation's way. But if Chronos requires more convincing, so be it.
However satisfying it must be to cut Chronos down to size, it's not reason enough. No, you and that Witch of the Crossroads must be brewing up some greater plan...
Forgiveness is like a precious healing ointment, to be applied sparingly.
Fine! That shall be all, I think. This type of squabble is beneath us both.
You wish to test me, I shall test you back, my dear. Please, do remember that.
{#Emph}Enough {#Prev}already! Here's a blessing that you could have had {#Emph}without {#Prev}a fight!
Your struggles only entertain me for so long. Begone already, girl.
Look at us, bickering like an old married couple! What say we move on?
Consider yourself reprimanded, my dear. Know that you got off lightly this time.
Oh, we've made enough enemies already that we {#Emph}hardly {#Prev}need more.
We're royalty, my dear. We ought behave with a more-regal bearing, yes?
{#Emph}Tsk! {#Prev}We ought be forming strong alliances, not at each other's throats.
Why are we fighting, blast? You truly {#Emph}are {#Prev}one of us to get such a rise out of me.
Well! Mustn't keep {#Emph}all {#Prev}our anger bottled up, yet always have some in reserve.
It's her.

2.Text: Queen Hera...

1.Text: Splendid.

2.Text: Very well.

HeraRejection01.Text: Need I remind you that I'm not particularly fond of those who turn their backs on me?

HeraRejection02.Text: How {#Emph}disappointing {#Prev}yet how typical this is! Now it's my turn.

HeraRejection03.Text: Whom do you take me for? You think I shall simply roll over and accept this?

HeraRejection04.Text: Perhaps you belong here on Olympus after all, showing such rudeness to me.

HeraRejection05.Text: Beware of angering me thus, my dear. You'll find I have an {#Emph}excellent {#Prev}memory.

HeraRejection06.Text: You would be wise not to forget yourself with me. {#Emph}Here! {#Prev}Let me remind you.

HeraRejection07.Text: Deep down, I value dissenting voices and opinions, but outwardly... {#Emph}no.

HeraRejection08.Text: We must maintain decorum; neither can we tolerate such insubordination.

HeraRejection09.Text: If you insist on siding against me, then I insist on making {#Emph}you {#Prev}regret it.

1.Text: We goddesses truly ought to be more committed to each other than {#Emph}this.
My husband is very accustomed to getting his way; you need not indulge him so.
This swarthy son of mine is more a draw to you than I? {#Emph}Hahaha!
When next my Husband and I have a little disagreement, {#Emph}side with me.
My warmongering son is likely to blame for all this, yet you choose {#Emph}him?
What my sister may lack for youth she makes up for with wisdom, is that it?
Smart girl.

2.Text: Good girl.

1.Text: You know, it's gotten harder sneaking down into the Underworld of late! Good thing I happen to know an expert on the subject. And so do {#Emph}you{#Prev}, I see!
Cheers for your business, on behalf of my erstwhile professional associate there! Feels good to be working together with that one again, you tell him I said {#Emph}hrrnnggh!
The boatman always takes his toll, that's just the way it is! Though the benefits are {#Emph}more {#Prev}than worth the asking price, you got my guarantee!
What do you guess my professional associate does with all that coin, really? He still won't say a word. Think he's just covering his tracks so Gramps can't pin him down!
How long you think it's going to take to do away with all that Chronos Gold, another {#Emph}age {#Prev}or two? Not that you're slow, mind, more that he minted an awful lot of coins right quick!
Nothing like a quick exchange of gifts!
I'm glad you're here, Hermes, and it's an honor to finally be working together. To our swift victory!

2.Text: Oh, hey! It's been a minute since I got an offering! Cheers, M, although you needn't have. But here, I've just the thing for you!

1.Text: Hermes, if there's anyone out there who can help me outpace Time, it's you. Please accept this, for your swift and reliable service.

2.Text: Right charitable of you, really, M, it's just I {#Emph}really {#Prev}need to move along, so let's get to the blessings if you please?

1.Text: If not for all your speed and bravery, we never would have had a fighting chance against our enemy, Hermes. I don't think we'll soon be able to repay you for this, but I can try!

2.Text: Right cordial of you, M, though I'm not much for tips and we've got pressing matters to attend to, don't you think? Though I appreciate it, honestly.

1.Text: I know you've been exceptionally busy as of late, though might I briefly interrupt our routine to give to you this little offering? It isn't much, but down here it's some of the best we've got.

2.Text: Don't know how you can find the {#Emph}time {#Prev}these days, though I am grateful that you thought of me like this! Now straight to business, then? Got lots to {#Emph}do!

1.Text: Where would we be without you, Lord Hermes? You've done so much to prepare us for the rigors we're having to endure. I know your efforts by their nature sometimes go unnoticed, but not by the Unseen.

2.Text: It's been a real pleasure working with you, M. One of the bright spots in all of this in fact! I keep my chin up no matter what, got to see where I'm going, right? Cheers for making it easy!

1.Text: To the swiftest of the gods, and one of my dearest, oldest comrades. Lord Hermes, you've served both Olympus and the Underworld, and you've seen it all. The rest of our family can learn so much from you. I know I could.

2.Text: I run around a lot and all. Been to a lot of places, met a lot of different characters, but you know what? You're still the best, I really mean it, M. You're not the {#Emph}fastest{#Prev}, mind! Can't have it all. But you and me? We cut it pretty close.

1.Text: Special delivery for you, Lord Hermes! You've aided me more times than I can count, and encouraged me every step of the way. I could never have come this far this quickly otherwise.

2.Text: Hey! Ambrosia! Just what I always wanted! Not seen it very often recently, nor the feasting that tends to go with it. Though at this rate we might soon have more! {#Emph}Feasting {#Prev}that is, which ought to be in your honor.

1.Text: To our esteemed Messenger, and my distinguished friend! Not only have you kept the bond between the Underworld and Olympus from fraying, you've done it swiftly and silently. You're practically a chthonic god yourself!

2.Text: That really means a lot, cheers, M. You know I like doing things fast, but the one thing I like even {#Emph}more {#Prev}is doing things well. We gods don't always have to work hard, but your father always did, and so do you. I'm glad I'm not alone.

1.Text: Cheers again for the Ambrosia, M. Not been much time for it though my professional associate and I managed to share a bottle recently. Short break, mind, but just what I needed!
Aphrodite's blessing on you, M? Impressive work, her graces are in {#Emph}very {#Prev}high demand! Much as she likes getting involved in personal affairs, yours surely is a special case!
Apollo's lighting up your life? Last thing he ever wants to do is get his hands dirty, but now, things being as they are, he doesn't have much of a choice I guess!
I know it was Apollo you expected, M, and he's quick! But I am quicker, and could beat him getting to you {#Emph}every time {#Prev}if I was a bit pettier than this! He'll be right with you soon.
Met Ares did you, M? Whenever there's a bloody dust-up, tempers flaring and all that, he will do everything he can to draw it out! This must be quite a big dilemma for him, mind.

Artemis and I weren't always close, each keeping to ourselves and all. But working with you and Hec brought us closer! We were so busy sneaking around, helped knowing we didn't have to sneak around each other!
You already caught up with Artemis, good good! She and I don't always chat, running around a lot, being discreet and all. But we exchange a knowing look from time to time!
Been good to see you and Artemis out and about a little more! She's got a mean bow but she can always use somebody out there drawing all the attention so she can line up her shots!
Athena's out there managing frontline defensive strategies and such. We mostly stay out of each other's way. She keeps her head in times like these, I'll give her that!
You run into a certain Underworld Boatman rowing about, you tell him I said hey? We've not collaborated much as before, what with everything of late. I miss those times!
So the Boatman's been all right, has he? That's good! I know that he's been looking out for Hec and the rest of you for a while now, but do look out for him in turn, would you?

You sure are a good customer to my professional associate, or so I'm hearing, M! I'm mostly hearing {#Emph}hrrrrnggh{#Prev}, mind, but I've seen how many of his Gold Rewards you're racking up, and it {#Emph}is {#Prev}quite a lot!

What a customer, the Titan of Time! I've not met Gramps before, though I can imagine what he must be like. Used to wonder how come my pop and his brothers were so dodgy sometimes. Now I know where they got it from!

You'd think the Titan of Time wouldn't be so stuck in the past, caught up in his idea of a {#Emph}Golden Age {#Prev}when {#Emph}he {#Prev}used to rule, and mortals hadn't a care in the world? Caring's not such a bad thing I think!
No way you could have already stopped Gramps by now, but going after him right when you did, you're buying us some time to put a little wrinkle in his plan. So {#Emph}cheers!
Ran into Lady Circe on your way last night, did you, M? She's quite the talent with those magick spells of hers. Liked turning mortals to all sorts of things! Bit {#Emph}mean {#Prev}if you ask me!
I've got a lot of regulars, but just between us, {#Emph}this {#Prev}one is my favorite, M. You Underworld types tend not to be too fussy, and you're clear with what you want. I like that about you!

For all that's happened, glad you finally met Demeter, even if only by Boon. She had a funny way of showing it sometimes but {#Emph}always {#Prev}loved your mum an awful lot. She'll fight to get her back, to the bitter end.

Some of our relatives don't like to get involved. Dionysus, he will go to every feast, but never to a fight! {#Emph}Why don't we all just get along{#Prev}, he says. Though, come to think... it's not a bad idea!

Some of the gods think Eris showed up near our mountain causing trouble again all because of you! They don't know I practically {#Emph}begged {#Prev}you to come up to our rescue over here. Think Hec gave you the order! We're really in it now...
Wise move having an animal companion along! I've got a soft spot for the quiet self-sufficient types. My little tortoise Chellen always feels at home wherever we go!

At least the family knows about you now! Always wanted to say, {#Emph}Message to Olympus! Persephone and Hades had another kid! And she's all right! {#Prev}But Hec knew we had to wait, and she knows a lot! So my lips were sealed.

So Gramps somehow got hold of the Three Fates! That isn't good, not sure what we can do about it, M. At least now everybody on Olympus knows, I figured it was time! Got us a bit on edge, though we do hide it pretty well!

Still have the matter of the Three Fates to be sorted out. So Gramps just sent them into exile and then entirely lost track? How are {#Emph}we {#Prev}supposed to find them if {#Emph}he {#Prev}can't...?

Keeping track of your best time, that's what I like to see! Take anything worth doing, then do it just as well a little faster, and a {#Emph}little {#Prev}faster, and soon, you'll be like {#Emph}me! Almost!
Notice you're not timing yourself anymore, and M? It breaks my heart. Not really, mind. Just find your speed, but still! Want to know how fast you are, there's only one way to find out.
You found your father down there, M! Never could get close enough myself, hope he's still all right. Hope {#Emph}everyone{#Prev}'s all right! We'll get them back, keep doing everything we can.
Known Hec a while, and don't envy either one of you. She couldn't just send you off to deal with Gramps before you were ready! You must have {#Emph}hated {#Prev}having to wait. I know I do!
You got Hephaestus to come out of his shell! All I can get from him are work orders, {#Emph}bring me more bronze {#Prev}and such! Glad you can put the fruits of all his labor to good use!

Hephaestus makes a {#Emph}mean {#Prev}set of armor, and you know what? He makes a mean pair of sandals, too. I wear mine all the time! {#Emph}Footwear{#Prev}, M! I really think it's going to catch on!
You know, I think my stepmum likes you quite a bit! Not to be taken for granted! Despite her specialties, I get the feeling our Queen Hera's not too keen on kids.
Ran into big old Heracles, did you? My stepmum's sent him on another labor of some sort. Got the feeling that his heart's not in it anymore. But hey, he's tough! And we could use the help.
So Hestia already got you, then? She's really rather spry despite her age. And likes to play with fire, too! Still just a kid at heart... one of those wee scary ones, mind!
You're moving right along there, M! Helps having that Metallic Droplet with you at all times. At least till it stops working for the night! Can't go top speed forever, but {#Emph}we try!
What a coincidence, it's you, and you're {#Emph}already {#Prev}quick! But you can always be a little quicker! Not me, though.
Well you are moving awful quick, and sure enough, you've got that Droplet from me there! You must be real used to it, and it'll keep delivering night after night, you've got my guarantee!
I like to talk sometimes but I like going quickly {#Emph}always {#Prev}so how about we keep these little conversations nice and brief from here? For the most part!

Hec always said you're quick to learn, you know? And sure enough, whenever I'd drop in, you'd be over a cauldron, working some new spell. Well, {#Emph}this is it! {#Prev}Your time to work some magick for our sake!

Officially, I'm keeping tabs on you, you're not supposed to know, just so you know. I tell Olympus {#Emph}all {#Prev}the latest happenings, nothing too private, mind; and then I tell {#Emph}you {#Prev}more! Just keeping tabs on everyone I guess!

These last few nights since you got started, all I managed to confirm is Gramps got hold of someone whom he's sure gives him the upper hand. Right now he's readying the next stage of his plan to bring this mountain down! I'd better go.

Nice snake-staff that you've got there, M, must be they're all the rage! These snakes of {#Emph}mine {#Prev}are from Apollo, helps remind me of the family, you know? Stuck together, skin not so thick, pitch hissy-fits sometimes... love 'em anyway.
Hec tells me Moros, son of Nyx, is staying with you for a bit down there? I thought he always stuck with the Three Fates. There's something going on, and I don't like it, M.

Hey, you made it to the finish line faster than ever last time! I may be keeping tabs, it's what I do, and maybe you won't {#Emph}always {#Prev}beat your best, but when it happens, it has {#Emph}got {#Prev}to feel good!

Guess what, last night, you made it to the end in record time, {#Emph}again! {#Prev}Keep getting faster like that and you'll soon be giving {#Emph}me {#Prev}a run for it, though I won't stand for that, you hear me, M?
You're taking something of a scenic route down to your father's House! Gramps has the major regions of the Underworld locked down, so... come to think, that makes a lot of sense!
You finally saw what it was like up here! Most of the others are holding out at the top of Olympus, and {#Emph}you {#Prev}are the reinforcements. So, come on back when you can, all right?
Olympus has been under siege before! Normally, it's not too big a deal. But Gramps has something else in mind this time. Got some individuals here pretty spooked!
You saw we stashed some goods for you up on our mountaintop, right M? It's just a bit out of the way for my professional associate, though we'll keep you supplied!
Had a feeling that I'd find you here one of these nights, you know? Like something's in the air. I'm all keyed up, just want to get things done as {#Emph}mega{#Prev}-fast as possible!

Something's odd about tonight though can't exactly put my finger on it, M. Though Hec says that lately you've been messing with the Pitch-Black Stone of yours, which always made me feel a bit like {#Emph}this!

To think I used to fill my days with whisking mortal newly-deads down to your father's realm! Honestly grew to like it soon enough, so even after Gramps showed up, I kept on stopping in when I could sneak a trip!

Your mum would travel back and forth between Olympus and your father's House, and {#Emph}I {#Prev}had the pleasure of accompanying her! One day, she didn't show up. I knew right then and there something was off...
That Cyclops waiting as you're heading out of town? Been there a while, thought eventually he would move on, but he did not! Gramps must have put him up to this...
Uncle Poseidon's blessing done you any favors yet this eve? Likes claiming it'll make you nigh invincible, but here's a little traveler's insurance just in case!
We've got more Titan problems than we figured, M. If Gramps could get Prometheus to take his side, who only knows what else. Ruffled a lot of feathers haven't we?

Prometheus and Heracles, turns out they're close, are they? Your little spat with them was shrouded by the dark but I caught glimpses of it here and there. I need to know about these things though doesn't mean I'll tell!

M, I know it's not an easy trip, or even possible for you right now, heading all the way up here. But just imagine how hard it is for our family to swallow our pride and ask for aid! Things are that grim!
Time of need here, M, and we need you at the bottom of the Underworld, {#Emph}and {#Prev}the top of Olympus! Two places at once, my sympathies. The {#Emph}trick {#Prev}is to move really, really fast!
Oh good! Selene got a hold of you already, M! Quite the vantage point the Eye of Night has got! Always looking out for you and all of us. Her steeds are pretty quick as well!
This is a proper spooky night, you had something to do with it, right M? My heart's racing nonstop! Whatever you've been up to in your Crossroads there, hope it works!

Hec says you spoke the Oath of the Unseen, so then I guess we're in for it, right M? The others might not know what's going on, it's just another eerie night, but you do what you have to do. Night's will be done and all.
You've never been one to back down from anything, huh, M. Well then that Oath of the Unseen is {#Emph}everything {#Prev}you ever wanted probably! Why go easy, when you could go hard?
You made it up here, M! I'll speed you on except this climate's going to be {#Emph}rough. {#Prev}You Underworld types and surface air! Must be something we can do about it, right...?

Hey M! Don't know exactly what you did, or maybe Hec, but you seem much much more yourself than last I saw. That's great! Because to make it all this way, you're going to need {#Emph}every {#Prev}bit of strength. And {#Emph}speed!

Hey M! You're here! That's great! Hec says you even got your Underworld blood-curse sorted so you're ready for a bit of a long-distance run. Just watch for bumps along the way, though let's speed you past them if we can!
The dead throughout Ephyra should be resting easy in your father's care, but Gramps shut it all down, flung open the Underworld's gates, and here we are. If I were dead, I'd be mad, too.

All right, so it's rough going on the surface for you, I get that, but don't give up on us yet, M. I know you {#Emph}never {#Prev}would, mind. Probably just searching for some magickal ingredients you need, something like that?
You found my special Shrines, good good! Some mortals pray to me both for safe travels and free stuff. {#Emph}Almost {#Prev}free. Small surcharge, mind! Associate has got to take his cut.
