Gramps sends forces to Olympus, we can send them whence they came, no sweat. But he's got something else in store, and whatever it is, it's big. Learn anything, let Hec know right away.

If only I could whisk you clear across the sea-rift that Poseidon carved out. But we {#Emph}mustn't {#Prev}get spotted working too closely together. And besides, you're helping us with every deck you swab! So {#Emph}cheers!

Something that scares me, M, is the idea that Time may be even quicker than {#Emph}I {#Prev}am. Remember back when you were real small! Well {#Emph}bam! {#Prev}You're {#Emph}old {#Prev}now, just like {#Emph}that!
Time sure is strange, don't you think, M? No surprise not even Gramps entirely understands it himself. I just don't like it when Time drags on for too long, so {#Emph}let's move!
Good news is we can now be sure what Gramps had planned for us, but bad news is, it's Typhon, and he's big. But my pop stopped him once, so how hard could it be...?
Who do you think can make it to the top of Mount Olympus first, M, you or old Typhon? You've got a longer way to go, sure, but you are definitely faster! Or about to be!

Typhon is gone for good?! My pop, he can't believe it still, but there has been no sign of that monstrosity up here since you last took him on! But why am {#Emph}I {#Prev}surprised? I figured if anyone could pull something like that off, it would be {#Emph}you!

You almost made it to the very top that time, and though it's not my wish to spoil the surprise, you {#Emph}ought {#Prev}to know we're dealing now with good old Typhon, Father of All Monsters! Isn't that just great...? We need you back here, M.
Hec says you're getting closer to a breakthrough there, with Gramps and Typhon and whatnot. Don't want to rush you, M, but this is {#Emph}me! {#Prev}I just can't help myself sometimes.

All this reminds of the time I backed your brother when he was searching for your mum! Had a vested interest in the outcome, sure. But before I knew it, I really started to care! We'll find a way to help them, won't we, M?
Saw your brother's back and doing well, that's great! Always was a tough sort, I figured he'd pull through. Who knows, maybe some evening he'll get {#Emph}you {#Prev}out of a bind!

One of these nights, maybe you could teach your brother how you breathe up here so he could pay us all a visit too? Eventually, I mean, after we're finished cleaning up for Gramps. The family always wanted Zag to stop on by.
Heard from my pop tonight already, M? He's always been a very busy god but never tires out. Now that you've got his lightning strength, how about some lightning {#Emph}speed {#Prev}to boot?
Both got some business to attend to, so let's get you on your way!
Thought I'd check up on you, everything good? Then good!
Things don't look great right now, but that can quickly change!
Sure, Time goes fast! But I think we'll be able to keep up!
Coincidentally was passing through with choice of blessings here!
Quick and quiet, M! You've got this, right?
In a bit of a rush, here, M, so let's get moving shall we?
{#Emph}Special delivery for the Princess of the Underworld!
Hey M, you need a lift? 'Cause I've got one. Three, in fact!
I'm scraping by. You scraping by? Let's scrape on by, why not?
They say to not be hasty, but then what do they know, right?
Live fast or not at all, right, M? Now take your pick!
We'll have you on your way in no time at all!
Figured you were due to get there right about now!
Don't think too much about this now, just snap one up and go!
Looks like we've got another busy eve ahead of us!
{#Emph}Hurry, M, before it's too late! {#Prev}I like saying that.
Got something here should put a real spring in your step!
All right, M, let's give {#Emph}you {#Prev}a little boost!
Oh hey! Thought I'd stop by, drop off a little something for you here!
We're in a race against Time, and so help me, we are going to win!
Nice night for a little jog, wouldn't you say there, M?
Hey! Got one of those special deliveries for you, M!
Only the best and swiftest service for my valued customers!
You headed up this way? Maybe I'll see you later on!
Want to make haste, then I got just the thing!
Lots going on! Been running around all night!
No calamitous attack on our family is going to slow us down!
Got to check up on a couple of things, but first, here!
Hey hey, M! One of those heys is from Artemis.
Hey hey, M! One of those heys is from Selene.
Let's keep the pace up and get rid of every last bad possibility!
It's been a busy night though I will always make the stop for you!
Think you can take out Typhon just like last time, M?
However many Typhon possibilities are left, let's make one less!
Got another mean old Chronos to take care of so don't let me keep you, M!
Choose quickly M, {#Emph}or else! {#Prev}Or else I'll wait. But I would rather not!
Don't just want to be quick, {#Emph}be {#Prev}quick! Including when you choose!
Got something I think you can use, and a couple others just in case!
Now take a moment to decide here M, but don't take more than that!
The busier we are, the more we do, and the faster the time goes by!
New moon, which means Selene gets a break, but you know who does not?
The sooner we get this done, the sooner we get to the next, and on, and on!
Don't keep me waiting, M, unless you want to kill me, in which case we can't be friends!
Used to always want you on the surface although lately I don't mind it either way!
Found you quick so you have got the whole rest of the night to hurry up!
Sure, the worst of our problems are over for now, but why slow down?
Somebody call for Premium Express delivery, hey, M? This is the {#Emph}best {#Prev}I've got, and it'll take you far and fast! You have my {#Emph}guarantee!
Fresh from the highest peaks of Olympus, it's the {#Emph}Premium Express! {#Prev}The finest, fastest blessings, for only the most discerning customers. That's {#Emph}you!
Hey, hear that, M? Why, that's the sound of {#Emph}Premium Express delivery{#Prev}! Always bringing {#Emph}you {#Prev}only the very best. So, make the most of it?
This time I've got my very best for you to choose from, M, though you should {#Emph}always {#Prev}expect quality from me! I just have even more of it than usual right now!
Looks like you hit a few bumps on your way there, M! Do watch your step, though when you're moving fast, I know it can be tough!
It's rough out there tonight, isn't it M? Well just hang on, and maybe one of {#Emph}these {#Prev}will help you go a little farther, {#Emph}faster!
Oh, no! You're hurt! What happened to you, M? Gramps must have got to you before I did! How is that even possible...?
That's not the safest place to travel, is it, M? So you picked up a scrape or two, so what! Now you'll pick up some speed!

You found them, M! The Fates! They told me so themselves, figured I'd spread the word, being a messenger and all, and you know what? They're {#Emph}right! {#Prev}Sounds like their time away gave them a change of heart...

The Fates supposedly are no longer deciding what'll happen from here out? Except big stuff, like new ages and such? Don't know {#Emph}how {#Prev}we're supposed to tell the difference, whether everything is planned by {#Emph}them {#Prev}or ours to decide...

Some sort of new age is in store then, take it you heard all about that firsthand, M. Guess it'll be here before we know it, as things like that tend to go! We'll be ready, and even if not, we'll act fast.

I'd say I can't believe you did it, M, but that would mean I didn't think you could, but I {#Emph}did{#Prev}, so I {#Emph}won't! {#Prev}But I {#Emph}will {#Prev}say: Cheers for {#Emph}everything! {#Prev}I know we might not be completely done, but if a bit of pressure's off now, good.

So far I'm liking this new Gramps of ours {#Emph}much {#Prev}better than the mean old Chronos from before. You'll have to tell me sometime how you turned his world upside down to make him be this way. Hec hasn't said a thing!
Your father's back where he belongs, your mother too, I'm really glad they're safe and sound together, M. You've got to make up for lost time with them, and you'll be able to from here on out!
Hey M! Heard you were heading out again, figured I'd drop on in, and send you off! Safe travels, and all that!
Long way to go from there, right, M? Well let's see if we can't cut out a little travel time to your next destination!
Thought I'd catch you right on your way out! Travel can be a very rewarding experience, but sometimes, you just want to get to where you need to be!
Another race to the finish line begins, hey, M? Well then, {#Emph}get set{#Prev}, because we'll have you there in no time flat! Provided you survive and all...
M, I would never mean to slow you down, especially as you get started for the night! So you go on and pick something, and then get {#Emph}out {#Prev}of there!
Thought you could sneak on out of there without me giving you my Boon, well you're entirely mistaken, M! And you're about to be much quicker, too!
You showed old Gramps who's boss! {#Emph}Good going, M! {#Prev}That ought to trip him up a bit. Fine time to come on up and help us drive his forces off {#Emph}our {#Prev}turf. What do you say?

No surprise old Gramps is a tough customer, but sorry he got you last night. And cheers for heading up {#Emph}this {#Prev}way! {#Emph}Time {#Prev}isn't going anywhere just yet, but this mountain might!
Oh great, you're headed up this way and not gone too far yet! Think you could make good time on your way here, although the choice is yours!
I know you can't breathe in our surface air forever, M, so it's a good thing I got a hold of you right as you're starting off! We'll get you to this mountaintop in practically no time.
Message from Olympus, M! It says {#Emph}Cheers for all the backup lately, since we know you could be down in Tartarus fighting with Gramps instead. {#Prev}Athena's words, not mine!
You're really helping tip the scales here! Broke through the siege and gave our relatives a minute of reprieve. Still isn't over, mind, but we can get there soon enough I think!

We really got him, M! Typhon, that is! I saw him tumble down the dark side of the mountain to the bottom and go {#Emph}boom! {#Prev}Then later saw him slowly get back up, and roar more angrily than ever, but hey!
I wouldn't have believed you're going after the remains of Typhon had I not seen the whole thing for myself! Time works in strange ways! And looks like you can put a stop to it after all. Some of it!
Another night, another Typhon down, but there are plenty more where he came from, is that your understanding, M? Glad those Typhons haven't been a problem for us here!
You made it pretty far down there before! Impressive work, I knew you had it in you, M! But Gramps still isn't backing down, is he? Maybe he's having second thoughts at least!

That wasn't Gramps himself you dealt with last night, but some sort of fluke of possibility that happened all because of how you dealt with him in the first place? I've seen a lot of things, M, but this is a first!
Last night marks one more mean old Chronos down I guess! Sounds like we've got a lot of them to go through, though I'm sure we'll start taking care of them faster and faster!
Had enough surface air for now, I get it, M. The more familiar path is often best! Either way, take this at your own pace. Don't anybody rush you! Except me.

Message from Olympus, M! It says {#Emph}How come you're toiling about the Underworld? We sure could use you way up here, it's just we're way too proud to ask! {#Prev}But {#Emph}I {#Prev}am not too proud.
Lord Hermes, go unseen.
You too!

2.Text: Hey hey!

1.Text: Lord Hermes...

2.Text: Special delivery...

1.Text: {#Emph}Oop!

2.Text: OK!

1.Text: Olympus needs me... on the surface?
{#Emph}Oh{#Prev}, there she is!

2.Text: Auntie Hestia's arrived!

1.Text: Having my Boon just stuffed into some unmarked sack, I {#Emph}swear! {#Prev}Halfway surprised it didn't burn right through. Sometimes it isn't easy getting hold of you, you know!
You probably could tell this was my Boon from all the heat must have been wafting from the parcel there! Surprised it didn't burn right up!
You must have had an excess of those golden coins that Chronos strewed across the land. To tempt the greediest of mortals, I suppose! Or the poorest. Not for me to judge!
That Boatman's good at taking messages, isn't he? Almost like taking corpses down into the Underworld like he used to. {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, nothing to do for those these days... except to {#Emph}burn!
You really have to pay that Charon character in these situations! What sort of daft system is {#Emph}that? {#Prev}What, no blessings for the poor? Doesn't seem fair at all.
My blessing made it all that way on just a rickety old wooden ferryboat? Must be a litany of fire-safety hazards there, although plenty of water near with which to put them out.
What, that ferryman having a fire sale there? Don't want you paying an exorbitant amount! Not that there ought to be a price on blessings, anyhow.
I don't take kindly to such acts.

2.Text: Trifle with me, and you'll get burned.

3.Text: Who do you take me for?

4.Text: Don't play with fire if you know what's good for ya.

5.Text: I'm long since done being a pushover, dearie!

6.Text: Looks like I cooked you for a bit too long, hot stuff...

1.Text: Come on, hop to it, hot stuff! While you've still got your looks! Not like Aphrodite here is going to let you hold to them forever. She doesn't care for competition, you can trust me on that.

2.Text: Sweet Hestia, whatever do you {#Emph}mean? {#Prev}I'll be the first to admit looks aren't {#Emph}everything. {#Prev}Who even needs them? But on the other hand, we're blessed to have someone of such vast wisdom and experience as {#Emph}you {#Prev}here on our side!

1.Text: All right, dearie, let's get a real fire going! No more fussing about merely with sparks and such. Oh, {#Emph}Apollo? {#Prev}Get your buttocks over here right now, 'cause I could use a light!

2.Text: {#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, right away, dear Lady Hestia! Though, might we please take more precaution not to burn down half the mountaintop this time...?

1.Text: We put poor mortals through an awful lot, no thanks to Ares here. Least he's been occupied with our own troubles for a change, haven't you, laddie? That way most everybody else can catch a break.

2.Text: But dearest Lady Hestia, our troubles are of grave concern to more than mortalkind! Ours is a conflict of the highest order, and irresistibly draws each of us to do our part.

1.Text: Would you believe it, hot stuff? I have on good authority that {#Emph}somebody {#Prev}around here's laid a claim to being {#Emph}Eldest of Olympus. {#Prev}Oh, Demeter? Care to explain {#Emph}that {#Prev}one?

2.Text: Hestia, you had {#Emph}abandoned {#Prev}us! To be an Olympian is not merely a birthright, but a {#Emph}pledge; {#Prev}both to this family, and this mountain. Restore your rightful status, and join me now to aid my granddaughter!

1.Text: Shame that all I can do for now is pepper you with Boons and such, hot stuff. I was just reminiscing here with Demeter about how we once took such matters into our own hands!

2.Text: If your wish is to fight again firsthand, no one is stopping you, dear Hestia. Whilst we may have long since given up the weapons that gave us our first great victory, between my frost and your flames, I think we can manage.

1.Text: If there's one thing I learned from my strong-armed nephew here, dearie, it's that you always have to strike while the iron's still hot. Now {#Emph}come {#Prev}on, {#Emph}hop {#Prev}to it, Hephaestus my lad!

2.Text: I'm hoppin', I'm hoppin', Lady, {#Emph}augh! {#Prev}Though if you keep on turning up the heat in here, then this whole {#Emph}forge {#Prev}is going to blow, and take the rest of the damn mountain with it, {#Emph}too! {#Prev}And what would witchie have to fight for then?

1.Text: Not always big on family business, though I take exception for my little sis. She of all goddesses has to put up with the most around here, and that's not even counting all this Chronos stuff. How do you manage it, {#Emph}O Queen?

2.Text: I manage it one evening at a time is how, Sister! Perhaps we shall have to burn the old world down and start anew, but... I can think of {#Emph}none {#Prev}more suited, should the need arise.

1.Text: Take our blessings but {#Emph}don't {#Prev}follow our example's what I say, dearie. A case in point's fish-faced Poseidon over here! Always trying hard to make a splash, {#Emph}never {#Prev}caring much who ends up getting wet. That about right, you big oaf?

2.Text: Quite on the contrary, dear Hestia! You're wrong at least on two accounts I think: First, I need never {#Emph}try hard {#Prev}to make a splash! I effortlessly do it every time. And second, don't you call me {#Emph}fish-faced{#Prev}, you mean wrinkly old hag, {#Emph}ha-hah!

1.Text: In olden days I never took strapping young Zeus here for the marrying type, and was none too pleased when he picked my poor sister Hera for the job! But you've been a right good husband to her, haven't you, Zeus?

2.Text: ...I sometimes pity you, Hestia, for never having known the joys of matrimony for yourself. Challenges arise in any such relationship, but together with your beloved partner, you find a way! All you must do is compromise and cooperate.

1.Text: The flame sigil...
What say we turn up the heat?!

2.Text: They'll burn!

5.Text: Here's a little warm-up for ya!

1.Text: Oh {#Emph}now {#Prev}you're cozying up?

2.Text: You're playing with fire, dearie!

1.Text: You dusted off old {#Emph}Hestia!

2.Text: Seems rather warm in here...!

1.Text: Lady Hestia?!

2.Text: Hestia, don't...!

1.Text: Something from Great-Auntie Hestia...
Dear Goddess Hestia, I hope you will accept this offering. It's a pleasure to have met someone with your warmth, wisdom, and strength.

2.Text: Well look at you, making me offerings! Such hospitality, and while I'd throw most customs to the flames, the old exchange of gifts is one that I don't mind. So here, something from me.

1.Text: Please accept this, Great-Aunt Hestia! Your generous support means a lot to me. I know there's so much I can learn from you.

2.Text: Come on now, I've nothing much to teach. You seem a recluse much the same as I, besides, although a looker still. But it's been nice to have made your acquaintance.

1.Text: Great Hestia, goddess of hearth and flame! May your spark burn always as brightly. You've helped me so much on my way!

2.Text: Why, thank you for that, dearie, you're too kind. Mortals were so convinced I only liked {#Emph}burnt {#Prev}offerings, they never gave me good stuff such as this.

1.Text: A tribute for dear Lady Hestia! Your bright flames are a guiding light, and bane to all our enemies. Though your keen wisdom and fiery spirit spur me on at least as much!

2.Text: No use buttering me up, you know. What, you think I'm going to withhold the best I've got unless you pay me some nice compliment? I can be petty, sure, but not {#Emph}that {#Prev}petty!

1.Text: If I'm to take another Boon of yours, Great Aunt, I bid you take another offering of Nectar from me! How you can carry yourself with such ease inspires me. If I could become more like you some ages hence, I would be very fortunate.

2.Text: You want to be like {#Emph}me? {#Prev}Now {#Emph}that's {#Prev}a first! What I wouldn't give to turn back time and have another go at things, knowing what I do now. Though come to think, we plan to turn back Time, don't we?

1.Text: Grand Auntie Hestia! More and more I wonder what would it have been like if you were always in my life. Perhaps I would have grown up quicker of wit? Or happier! May we yet get to know each other like we knew each other all along!

2.Text: I never wanted kids, you know, dearie. And you're not about to make me second-guess what's more than probably the smartest choice I ever made, mouthing off to me the way you did just then! Now {#Emph}take {#Prev}your blasted Boon and off with you!

1.Text: It must have been you who inspired me to make a warm and happy home, Great-Auntie! This Ambrosia, in turn, is for sharing with all those who make your own home feel safe and comforting, the way I feel whenever you call.

2.Text: {#Emph}Oh {#Prev}this is right sweet of you, dearie, and you're on to something there! So many want to be famous or successful and such, but to be safe and comfortable? Nothing beats that, and I know you know. {#Emph}May you be always.

1.Text: You bear the gift of Aphrodite, don't you, there? You know, she's much, {#Emph}much {#Prev}older than she looks. Appearances are everything to her, whilst as for me, I'm about hotness of a different sort...

Why, the flamboyant god of light has put a little {#Emph}sparkle {#Prev}on you, hasn't he? Shines like the sun, Apollo does, {#Emph}oh sure! {#Prev}But there's more than one way to light up a place, you know.

You know Ares by now, don't ya, dearie? He's cool-headed more than some of us, sure, but I think something's wrong with him. The only kind of warmth {#Emph}he {#Prev}cares for comes from fresh-spilled blood and flames of battle and the like.
So it was Artemis who sniffed you out, was it? Seems like an awful big coincidence, but then we're gods, these things they happen all the time! I'll say I'm glad she found you when she did.
You've quite a lot of Ashes, haven't ya? The remains of the past. Humbling to even think about, that the greatest monuments and forests and whatnot can be reduced to {#Emph}that.
We're not too worried here right now what with Athena holding down the fort. She can be a little much if you two ever meet, but out of everybody here, she'd be the first I'd pick to watch my back.

I'm sensing something different in you there, dearie. It's like a divine mark of ours but it's most certainly not anybody's here. It's positively ancient, even next to me! Got some old friends that we don't know about?

You should have seen it, dearie, when we brought old Chronos down! Took six of us, at least, but we got him! Little wonder he's all sore about it still. We'll just have to dispose of him more thoroughly! {#Emph}Cremation{#Prev}, mayhaps?

I still remember how it felt when we showed Chronos what we younger generation were made of! Now {#Emph}you're {#Prev}the younger generation, dearie, dealing with the same old problems and worse. Some things never do change!
You and old Hecate, you must be sorting out some way to keep that Chronos from recovering, lest you wouldn't keep on going after him like this! You getting any warmer yet?

We've been holding our own up here against that Chronos and his forces, but there's something going on, oh I can feel it. Whatever the Titan thinks he has in store, however, I suspect that it can {#Emph}burn...
We don't quite know what Chronos has been cooking up for us, but we're all thinking that his little recent skirmishes against our mountainside are not the brunt of it. Not keen here to find out.

Got yourself some Cinder there, don't ya? Not a flashy substance, but it's strong, good source of flame! Most gods and mortals only care for shiny baubles and the like. But some of you witches rather know your stuff!

You're loaded up with Cinder, aren't ya? That much of it I can detect from here... a special kind from torches I know well. Some remnants of your bouts with Hecate? You can't really be fighting. Probably just your nightly exercise!
I know you've all this Chronos business to sort out but want to say, I can appreciate that you're attempting to make life a little cozier back home. Make things warmer and old Hestia can tell!

Never been to where you live but I can tell when someone's made a warm and happy home, such as they can. Decorations, little touches for a sense of welcome, that's the stuff! Not everybody gets it but {#Emph}you {#Prev}do.

You're used to living in darkness, aren't you? Up here, darkness is widely feared. Even in the warmth of my firelight, they jump at shadows, mortals and even gods sometimes! They trust their weak eyes overmuch I think.

My frosty little sister Demeter has been in touch already, I can tell! Your nan fancies herself the {#Emph}eldest of Olympus{#Prev}, she does! Only true because I'm usually not here. Mayhaps she left you cold, well not to worry, I have {#Emph}just {#Prev}the remedy!

Poor little sister Demeter. She bore but one child, a girl, dearie. Persephone, your mum! And even still, that child caused her at least as much grief as joy. It's not your mum's fault, mind. She was a lovely one, with hair like yours.

I don't even want to know what's going on with Dionysus anymore. The worse things get, the more he's wanting to cut loose! Whole blasted world could be aflame and he'd just let it burn! Could use some of his wine right now...

What happened to those Flames of yours? Now shining almost like the break of Dawn. Mayhaps that rosy-fingered Eos has decided to pitch in! Much as we'd hate to interrupt her from the one thing on her schedule each day...

The city of Ephyra burns, but it's not entirely my fault! Flames are like a tool, I suppose... one of those things requiring precaution on one's part. Lose something in a fire, sorry! Can't help you with that!

You had a bad run-in with that wretched Eris on your way here, eh? Just {#Emph}great{#Prev}, to know that Strife herself is up against us now! And got her grubby little fingers on my Rail of Adamant... I ought have kept the thing.

Heard you plucked that nasty Eris from the sky! Well, serves her right! Though we could never make her stay away for good. To think she's one of {#Emph}Nyx's {#Prev}many pups! Squeeze out a big litter like that, you're liable to get a runt.
That Eris keeps on getting in your way, even though Chronos himself has stood down and Typhon's dead and such? Well, she's as stubborn as {#Emph}we {#Prev}are, I am practically impressed!

Things have not exactly gone our way, dearie. 'Specially if what I'm hearing about the Fates is so. Whether we ought to be in charge or no, it's they that put us here... and now they've vanished like a puff of smoke?

You made it all the way down to the Mourning Fields before? A horrid place, or so I hear, and covered in dry brush, far as the eye can see. Well next time you're there, you burn your way on through! Hear me, hot stuff?

You might be wondering, {#Emph}Great-Auntie Hestia, when does the fighting ever cease? {#Prev}Well, I invite you to imagine back when I was closer to your age... a little leaner, little feistier, but not too different, all in all. We've been fighting ever since.
For every candle that you light, for every cauldron that you boil, that's {#Emph}my {#Prev}flame working its own magick for you, dearie! So you just think of me whenever the sparks fly.
Funny thing about flame, dearie, it's warm and pretty, isn't it? But it can kill you in a couple of licks. Really makes you think! And really makes you burn to a crisp, if you're not careful...
Your dad and I got on all right, comparatively speaking, I suppose. After we put the Titans in their place, though, he went down into your Underworld, and I drifted away, like a spark from a flame...

Your dad and I, we've got a lot in common, I suppose. The two {#Emph}not-technically-Olympians! {#Prev}At least I get to visit when I want, whereas poor Hades, soon as he got saddled with the Underworld, they never counted him among their kind again!
I sure am glad to know your dad's all right. Him and your mum, your brother, everybody from that House of his. May they all be warm and comfortable together there.
The hearth-flame of this mountain started sputtering a bit after Typhon decided to show up. It's since been burning bright and hot, but I've been tending to it plenty, just in case.

Old Hecate's your teacher, is that it? Known her since I was probably {#Emph}your {#Prev}age, right proper dame! Been far too long since last we saw each other, come to think. {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, what can you do? She hates everybody, I hate everybody.
I'm pleased to know you and Hephaestus get along. That one, he's often on his own, as though my flames are all the company he needs. He's not the worst of sorts as we gods go.
Already had a brush with sister Hera, have you, now? She's more accustomed to attending youngsters such as you, but then again, she's got her own to deal with. So why not stick with me?

Our young Queen Hera, she'd always say one ought to keep her feelings bottled up and carefully in check. Look where that attitude got her! I say let loose your temper and your rage. Let it {#Emph}all {#Prev}out!

Oh while you're up here do watch out for Heracles, big burly sort of man? One of the best we've got but sometimes gives the sense that he's become unhappy with his job. How that is possible, though, is beyond my ken!

Done had a chat with Hera, with {#Emph}Queen Hera {#Prev}I should say, about how maybe we can all go easier on Heracles after all this. He ought to put down that big club of his and have a good long sit!
You've got a real spring in your step if I'm not mistaken, dearie! The handiwork of swiftest Hermes, I suppose. You know what else moves awful quick? Here, let me give you a little hint!

See they've got statues of me up here now, dearie? They didn't use to, but the others, they've been trying to get me back into the fold, pay me respects, there's a nice thought! But I don't want to see my own mug all the time!
How come you're not living in the House of Hades with your mum and dad? Must be nice and cozy there all deep beneath the Earth. Well, a House isn't always a home. Mayhaps you like your woods...
Shade of that lad Icarus has been flying about, has he? Seems rather handy having him around, all soaring like a bird. And his new wings don't look like they can melt!

You got my Everlasting Ember, haven't you? Can faintly see its flicker even here. Your way of signaling to your Great-Auntie Hestia, and all the rest, that you are hankering for Boons with just a {#Emph}little bit {#Prev}of spice!
See how that Everlasting Ember keeps on giving? It's right there in the name, dearie! Glad you saw that it was good for something, means I get to stay plenty active at my age!
Odd sort of flame you've got this eve, if it can even be considered flame at all. So that's one of Nyx's weapons, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Changing their shape like the old Infernal Arms would do.

We ought have been kinder to mortals, really. Then Chronos would've had a harder time compelling the dead to rise against us! I've always tried to look after the living. But our family's best known for looking after ourselves.
The mortals used to make us many offerings, giving up their own food and the like. They always praised me first among the gods, for it's my fire they used when making sacrifice. It was very sweet!

The others don't agree with me on this, dearie, but you're still young, mayhaps impressionable, so... well {#Emph}I {#Prev}think mortals ought to get from us a bit more than we give. If the Fates are saying it'll happen down the line, then good!

The others, each in their own way, they do like when mortals make them subjects in their tales and songs. Well, not {#Emph}I! {#Prev}In that regard I think you Underworld gods are in the right. Best keep our business to our own damn selves!

Where in those bloody depths {#Emph}are {#Prev}you, dearie, underneath the sea?! It's hard to get a blaze a-roaring when there's water all about, but if you can handle the pressure down there, I can bring the heat!

Know what this family's problem is, dearie? It's just too big! The others act as though they pity me, {#Emph}poor childless Hestia{#Prev}, they say! But they all long for their childless days, I can see it in their eyes.

I almost pity you, dearie, all swept up in our affairs! You don't know how hard I've tried to avoid it myself. Must we always have to take a blasted side in everything? But we gods, we just love a good fight...

I figured we could use you, dearie, no real surprise. But, I didn't expect we'd {#Emph}like {#Prev}you, which is to say you're young, you've got your different customs and whatnot. We can be hard to get along with! But you're {#Emph}doing {#Prev}it!

Just earlier I felt the strangest urge to seek you out, dearie! Almost as though it wasn't even me deciding it! Messing with eldritch forces or somesuch? Well if you want to gaze into the cold abyss, I'll keep you nice and warm.
Don't know how you got so far so quick tonight, hot stuff, but you're not going any farther till you're properly prepared. Got to bring plenty of {#Emph}heat {#Prev}where you're going!
Still don't quite know how you're getting all that way in but a flash once in a while. Mayhaps some of your witch-magick! Long as you don't sputter out before you get to the end.

You didn't even get the Palace tour, Hera says. {#Emph}Aw{#Prev}, dearie, if only I could have been there to show you around instead of tending to our flames. But then again, you see one of our fancy columns, mayhaps you've seen 'em all.
Been on your own all this time, haven't you? Well, might be you're better off. Wish I never knew {#Emph}my {#Prev}blasted dad and mum! They taught me nothing I couldn't have learned better on my own.

Someday I'd like to see the River Phlegethon you've got down in the Underworld! A river full of {#Emph}flame... {#Prev}tried making something like that here on our side, but it sent mortals panicking, and the gods didn't much care for it either...

You had it out with Polyphemus, so I hear! Recall distinctly how he lost his eye. Let's say {#Emph}flame {#Prev}played a vital part and leave it there. Almost felt sorry for the lad, but he's been getting by. And getting in your way...
Blessed already by the mighty god of earth and sea, are ya? Poseidon's power and my own don't often mix, but then again, neither do he and I, of that you can be certain, there, dearie.

So the Titan of Foresight slipped his chains and fights against us now! A pity, that. Been on the outs with us ever since we caught him red-handed with my flames. Stole fire for the sake of mortalkind! Could have just asked me nice!

Prometheus, he never seemed to lack for smarts as I recall. Was a right level-headed sort, but now? He's serving Chronos, making mayhem for us here! They say he sees the future, so he must know he won't get away with this...

I figured once we got to Chronos, that Prometheus would not be far behind, longing for the days his liver was an eagle's snack. I know he's been a problem, but... I don't want to see him go through that again. Don't properly know why...

I know Prometheus supposedly can see what's coming up, but I just can't believe he saw all {#Emph}this! {#Prev}Suppose I should be madder at him, but... least it seems like he's been looking out for mortals still.
Got sent home by Prometheus, I heard. Well if he burned you don't go putting ice on it, no matter what Demeter says. You witches must have ointments and the like...

Don't let us keep on jerking you around, all right? First we got you going after Chronos, now we got you coming here to our defense, {#Emph}blast! {#Prev}Though just in case nobody's said it yet, we {#Emph}really do {#Prev}appreciate the help.

{#Emph}Augh{#Prev}, I'm proper tired now, you know? Incinerating this and that, on and on, it's taxing after a while! I'll keep on backing you, dearie, but might not be as much for chitchat for a bit.
You've got Selene's moonlight shine on you, eh? I'll not deny it has a certain power and allure... but such a cold and distant light, next to a scorching flame? There's no comparison!
Something about this night gives me the proper chills, hot stuff. It's like the darkness is so thick, it suffocates! And problem is, you can't have fire without air. Careful, all right?
It's downright sinister out there; can't hardly see a thing. But you know what? Where there's flame, there's light. So stick with me! Together we can make it through the darkest times.

{#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, this mountaintop. Gave up my seat here, you know. Wanted to see the world, not my blasted sisters everyday! But now I'm stuck here with the lot of them. Burns me right up, even to think about!
Guess what, hot stuff, your Great-Aunt's back again to turn your foes to soot! Best way to make it so they never bother you again, though tidying up can be a bit of a pain...
Strange contraption that you're using to make everything blow up! I got odd glances too when I still had the Rail of Adamant, but it could make 'em look away right quick.

Well look at those fancy flames you've got, sputtering their sparks all uncontrollably! That is a safety hazard, dearie. Back when I was shooting fire at my foes, it sure was not an automatic thing. You youngsters have it {#Emph}easy {#Prev}now!

Well, look at you, hot stuff, you made it to the surface after all! I figured that you might. It's maybe even colder here than down below, but {#Emph}that{#Prev}, at least, we can fix right away, I think!
Mortals go from worshiping the flame to fearing it. As well they ought! The hearth-fires of every home there in that wretched city you reside in, all of them burned out. Not that I'm mad, oh no.

Poor thing, been all cooped up inside that Underworld, haven't you? There's a whole great world to see out there, once your business is done. Do let me know, I can suggest some wondrous spots not far from here!
You're not supposed to be up here, are ya? Don't think your dad's permitted back up top, at least. But you're a witch, must be you've got your cures for everything under the sun!

Titans, gods, still couldn't tell you what's the bloody difference anyway! Don't look much different, don't sound much different. Not an age thing, {#Emph}that {#Prev}I can attest! It's just a handy way to brand our enemies.

What's that you got there, Ygnium is it? Reminds me of those twin torches that old Hecate would always have with her. If these are anything like those, they'll never sputter out. But just in case, we'll keep them nice and hot!

Since Typhon's back, I thought I'd say {#Emph}nice knowing you, dearie! {#Prev}Not that we're going down without a fight, but just in case. We barely beat him when we first settled up with Chronos way back when! But now he's grown, a {#Emph}lot!

Don't quite know how we're managing to hold back Typhon from reducing this whole mountaintop to ash. Must be the lightning, flames, floods, and earthquakes and the like! If you've got any bright ideas yourself, just come on up!

That bloody monster's down and out? And I mean out for good, as in, we can't find any trace of him at {#Emph}all! {#Prev}They're telling me you turned Typhon to {#Emph}ash{#Prev}, dearie! That's proper scary stuff...!
Great stuff, dearie, giving bad Chronos and then Typhon the old one-two! You make this stuff look proper easy now. Mayhaps I should give it a go myself one of these nights?
Well you are seriously on a hot streak there, hot stuff! No wonder I've been calling you that, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Every night you're coming back with something in the bag, you keep that up!

So you're a bit of a witch, are you? Well, not I! Stuck with {#Emph}this {#Prev}family already, don't see why I'd want another one. But I understand the appeal, I suppose. Plenty of candles and fire to it, isn't there?

{#Emph}Oh{#Prev}, the mighty ruler of Olympus gave to you a bit of his {#Emph}thunderous might{#Prev}, did he now? Well that's not going to take you very far at all, so let me set you up with a {#Emph}little extra firepower {#Prev}here.

{#Emph}Ohh{#Prev}, I was something in my glory days. Lots of suitors. {#Emph}Pfeh! {#Prev}I was a crack shot with the Rail of Adamant. You heard of it? Monstrous thing, gave it up. Gave up warring altogether! Until now, apparently!

{#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, the passions of youth! I've smoldered away, not much of a feast for the eyes at this point. Fine. But {#Emph}you? {#Prev}Still just a kindling. Though, we'll make an inferno of you yet!
{#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, let's {#Emph}burn {#Prev}it all down, what say you, dearie?
We'll turn that flicker in your step into a roaring flame!
What say we make a cozy little fire, then put all our enemies in it?
Looks like we've got a properly hot night ahead of us!
Everything's going to be covered in soot by the time we're through!
Don't let the fire in your heart sputter out, all right?
{#Emph}Hoh{#Prev}, let's have a look and get you good and fired up again, dearie!
All right, hot stuff! We're turning up the temperature to get things roaring, then!
Been far too long since we incinerated stuff together, hasn't it?
Sometimes, you just have to {#Emph}burn {#Prev}everything to the ground and go from there, hot stuff.
Sure everything's rotten, but between us girls, I've not felt this alive in some time!
They say never to play with fire, dearie. But you have my permission to go {#Emph}right {#Prev}ahead!
Time to turn the heat up to full blast, isn't that right, dearie?
Got another little warm-up for you right here, hot stuff!
Must be cold down in your whereabouts... but not for long!
I'm here again, dearie, so cozy up as we're about to have a real {#Emph}blast!
This old flame can never be put out, and don't you forget it, dearie!
{#Emph}Oh{#Prev}, if I could only roast more of our blasted enemies myself!
Warmest wishes to you, dearie, and a little something extra on the side!
Some evening, mayhaps you'll settle down to a nice comfortable life, but {#Emph}ohh{#Prev}, not tonight!
Sacrifices sometimes must be made, dearie. So round them up and put them to the flame!
We're in for a {#Emph}hot one {#Prev}this evening, oh I can already tell!
You burn proper hot even without my aid, but {#Emph}with {#Prev}it, {#Emph}oh, hohoho!
What's cooking there this eve, dearie? Whatever we damn well please, that's what!
Well now I reckon it's time to fan the flames a bit, isn't it then?
I've been cooking up a little something special just for {#Emph}you{#Prev}, hot stuff!
Is something burning over there, dearie? Well it's about to be!
Let's keep that everlasting flame alive and well, what say you, hot stuff?
Well at least we're living in exciting times, I'll give us that!
What say we add a little fuel to this fire we've got going, why don't we?
If mortals can't be having cozy-time, then I've a mind to say, {#Emph}nobody {#Prev}shall!
We could be sitting comfortable beside a fire sipping Nectar or somesuch, but {#Emph}no!
You're always dressed for warmer temperatures full knowing that Great-Auntie won't be far!
Time we start cooking again, hot stuff, while the night's still young and all!
What say we light up the night, dearie, using whichever kindling is at hand?
I've seen an awful lot in my time, but all this lately, got to say it's a bit new!
Never let that fire in your gut go out, dearie, but don't let it burn too hot either!
Don't let any of this get to you as it'll all blow over soon enough, always does.
Time again to let the sparks fly, {#Emph}eh? Oh {#Prev}I'm ready whenever you are!
Heading to our mountain's tippy-top again? Then let's make sure you don't catch cold.
If they wanted me to stay out of this, they shouldn't have gone for our home!
Sticking to the underground is not a bad idea! You're likely better off living down there.
I thought the fire goddess never got involved? {#Emph}In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message!

2.Text: Well, look at you, hot stuff! Come to help the elderly, {#Emph}ah {#Prev}what a good girl you are. And here I was just about to burn this whole blasted place to the ground myself! Now, here's a little {#Emph}warm-up {#Prev}for ya...

1.Text: Even I'll admit the quaint crackle of the hearth just doesn't always do the job. Sometimes, what we need is a great big conflagration, an inferno of the highest order! How about one, then?

The hearth is at the center of the mortal household, dearie, keeping my flames comfortably in place. But I can make a wildfire in a {#Emph}snap! {#Prev}And when I get angry, that's {#Emph}exactly {#Prev}what I do.
Oh, dearie, you look {#Emph}terrible{#Prev}, what happened to you there? Well maybe you can sweat it out or something. Would that I could cauterize your wounds!
{#Emph}Tsk, ooh{#Prev}, you've had more than a scrape or two, there, haven't you? {#Emph}Augh{#Prev}, such is life! Bite down and press on through, that's how we end up in a better spot.

{#Emph}Ohh{#Prev}, looks to me like you've been through a {#Emph}lot! {#Prev}Well if you find yourself in a bad place, you just push on through! Or go scorched-earth on everything around you if you must.
Oh dearie, if you're all banged up from head to toe like this, then you're in no shape for the next stage of our little firefight! So pull yourself together, {#Emph}eh?

You found those little weaver-sisters did you now? Just when I thought they'd left the lot of us for good! Don't quite know what to make of their new prophecy, but time eventually will always tell with those.

When all of this is over, I am liable to keep on wandering about I think. See how the mortals and the world are faring, can't do that as easily from on high. Olympus can be nice to visit but I never wanted to live here myself.

{#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, I like a girl who's ready to gird up her loins, get her hands dirty and the like. Too many just waiting for someone to clean their messes for them, blast it all. Speaking of, why don't you go and do some {#Emph}blasting {#Prev}for me, eh?

We've burned bright on Olympus I don't know how long already, dearie. Suppose our time has come and gone? Mayhaps we're more like mortals than we care to admit. Well, whatever doom awaits, I welcome it!

You really are an odd one, hot stuff. At first I thought you were a little stuck up, much like some others whom I happen to know only too well. But you truly are committed to righting this wrong from before your time, aren't ya?

What's gotten into Chronos, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}One moment it's the same-old same-old war, and then the next, he shows up on our mountain all contrite! I know you witches can be serious but this was well past what I reckoned you could do!

I got so worked up I didn't properly congratulate you last time, dearie! Bless you for everything! You found us in the middle of a real mess and got us out. Sure we helped and all, but you did the cooking, and you did it good.

Zeus and Hera had this daft old plan for stopping Typhon that involved Hephaestus and his forge and just a wee bit of my flame to get things started. This whole countryside should be glad we didn't go with {#Emph}that.
Why hello, dearie, getting ready for your next excursion, there? You're just a glowing ember for the moment, so how about we get you good and fired up?
Now don't go wandering into the dark without a proper light! And I don't mean the kind Apollo's offering, although mayhaps I'd settle for the Moon. Anyhow, no matter, {#Emph}here!
Think you can slip right out of there this late without my noticing? Well, typically you can, but not this time! And your punishment is a fine selection of hearth-warming Boons!
So, headed up this way again? Won't be hearing any arguments from me! Not sure you can hear me at all down there, come to think. Anyhow, let's get you {#Emph}all warmed up!
Decided to come up for air again, hot stuff? Sure, the Underworld must have a lot to see and do, but with respect! It cannot possibly compare to everything we've got up here.
You must live somewhere 'round those parts, don't you, dearie? Well, since it seems a little cold out there tonight, why don't we make some {#Emph}temperature adjustments {#Prev}here...
Surviving's hard enough, but all you Underworld types, you're not supposed to be up top at all! No wonder you've gone back below, I'd do the same without a second thought!

You helped us {#Emph}beat {#Prev}that bloody monster {#Emph}down! Ah{#Prev}, if only I could have seen! You're really something else, hot stuff! Of course our good friend Typhon's already begun on his climb back up. We'll just have to make it extra tough for him...

Regards for helping clear the air a bit up here! Bought us a little moment to recover and regroup. Now everybody's all fired up again to break the siege! {#Emph}Augh{#Prev}, but listen to me! All about the warring like the rest of them...

So let me see if I understand: Though you rid us of Typhon, you are now supposed to hunt down what remains of him, somewhere out of this bloody world? {#Emph}Oh {#Prev}you can't catch a proper {#Emph}break{#Prev}, hot stuff! But I have got your back.

You know it's a bit frightening to think we're up against what could potentially be many thousands of Typhons now... Typhon {#Emph}possibilities {#Prev}I reckon is the phrase. Least we only need to deal with 'em one at a time!

They're saying that you gave him one from all of us! Chronos, that is. A right proper old fashioned {#Emph}beating{#Prev}, that is! Must have felt all warm and cozy, didn't it? Makes you want to do it again and {#Emph}again!

You got that bloody Titan, didn't ya? Don't feel too bad you couldn't end him altogether, not like any of the rest of us were able to, as you can plainly see. Instead, mayhaps go kick him while he's {#Emph}down! {#Prev}Happy to help with {#Emph}that!

We've relegated Chronos to a cushy job down in the Isles of the Blessed, how nice for him, I get that. But you're still working with him to fight him to stop him from rising to power, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Well I suppose I get that, too!

We heard you tidied up one more of those bad Chronoses last night! Plenty of bad ones left apparently. The one we're stuck with might be odd, though I suppose I'm glad you didn't have to blow {#Emph}him {#Prev}up.
How many of those bad Chronoses have you wiped out already, hot stuff? Must be kind of nice seeing that smug old look on his face turn sour again and again!
That there is what I call the {#Emph}first {#Prev}degree. Like letting you off with a {#Emph}little {#Prev}warning!
I like you, dearie. So I'm not going to turn you to ash {#Emph}this {#Prev}time. But later down the line, no guarantees.
So you got yourself a slap on the wrist! Might want to pour some nice cool water over that.
{#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, you're all right, and {#Emph}I {#Prev}am now all right, so I suppose that {#Emph}everything's {#Prev}all right.
Fine, no need to get all hot and bothered for too long about this sort of thing. So let's just carry on!
Got just a little steamed back there, but I am back to my usual quite irritable self, thank you!
Well, there we go again! You know they take me for the calm and peaceful one around here?
Play with fire and you get yourself burned! It's just as simple as that unless I say otherwise.
All right, all right, let's just cool off a bit before these flames of mine get {#Emph}way {#Prev}out of control...
I like a lass who knows how to snap back! Don't ever let anybody up here push you around.
Fine, let's turn down the temperature a bit if we're right finished squabbling for now.
I wasn't always quick to anger, dearie, so turns out I'm not too old to learn!
It's Great-Auntie...

2.Text: Hestia...

1.Text: {#Emph}Hah! {#Prev}Fine.

2.Text: {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, all right!

HestiaRejection01.Text: Has old Hecate not taught you to respect the elderly a little more than {#Emph}that? {#Prev}Well, here's a quick lesson for ya!

HestiaRejection02.Text: Won't do for all the rest taking old Hestia for a pushover in matters such as this. So I've got to burn you up a bit!

HestiaRejection03.Text: Don't want my blessings while they're good and hot, do ya? Then {#Emph}this {#Prev}ought to warm you up in the meantime.

HestiaRejection04.Text: Not really mad at you, dearie! But I don't have the energy right now to go against the daft traditions that we have.

HestiaRejection05.Text: {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, a right good burn like that deserves another. Only fair, don't you agree, hot stuff?

HestiaRejection06.Text: Just look at the {#Emph}bickering{#Prev}, sorry mess we've become! But we've all got to pull our weight, don't we?

HestiaRejection07.Text: Here I was trying to lend a helping hand, but {#Emph}no! {#Prev}Somebody's always getting in my way. Well I {#Emph}won't {#Prev}have it!

HestiaRejection08.Text: Come on now, even mortals know it's best to honor dear old Hestia first and foremost when it comes to such things!

HestiaRejection09.Text: Gave up the Boon of Hestia, did ya? Well then how about a quick reminder of the proper way to make a sacrifice!

HestiaRejection10.Text: Try as I might, I cannot help feeling a little miffed at that! And I am not someone to simply let it slide...

1.Text: Now where do you get off picking one of my younger sisters over me, {#Emph}eh?

HestiaRejection12.Text: You think you're playing it safe, but you're not. I'm through getting pushed to the side!

1.Text: A Pom of Power...!
These Poms are even here...
A Daedalus Hammer...
An Icarus Hammer...?
My silver shines.

2.Text: Further refined.

20.Text: My blades shine like the Moon.

1.Text: Hoy there my niece!

2.Text: Good tidings to you, Niece!

1.Text: Hoy, for it is I {#Emph}again{#Prev}, good Niece! Although presumably you must have known, as likely all the unmarked packaging concealing this Boon was soaked all the way through!

{#Emph}Surprise! {#Prev}You are the fortunate recipient of my almighty Boon! Which means the legions of Chronos are in for an even {#Emph}bigger {#Prev}surprise... and not the {#Emph}good {#Prev}kind!
That old Underworld Boatman yet eludes the grasp of Chronos, does he? Turned to a life of the piratical smuggler in these dark times, {#Emph}augh!
I fail to see why coin need change hands for a blessing from your uncle, though come to think, such blessings are most valuable indeed!
Whatever Gold you paid ought to be at the bottom of the sea! Who does that Chronos think he is, showering mortals with shiny metals?
I trust your Boatman there appreciates that the smooth sailing he's experienced in his mercantile routes is no coincidence at all?

Now that's a trim ship, with the Underworld Boatman at the helm! Perhaps I ought not call him {#Emph}Underworld Boatman {#Prev}anymore, for he's become a proper {#Emph}captain {#Prev}now! I'll have to keep the currents clear for him!
That Underworld Boatman, he can't sail to this mountaintop! Unless he fashions for himself a craft that sails on air, he shall be relegated to my waters! But how then did he get his goods up here...?
You mess with the sea, you get sunk. Remember that!

2.Text: {#Emph}Augh{#Prev}, blasted temper of mine! Seems I lost it again!

3.Text: You sailed right into the rocks like a young fool.

4.Text: I am not easy to offend, yet here we are!

5.Text: You make me angry, I won't let you off the hook!

6.Text: Enough of this, we've bigger fish to fry!

1.Text: When battle rages all around, there's little time for love, little room for beauty! Yet Aphrodite here, she never loses heart! It's almost precious how she strives with all her might, brandishing that decorative spear of hers!

2.Text: Well, good Lord Poseidon, I'm pleased to know how I {#Emph}inspire {#Prev}you. Though perhaps you ought pay more attention to our {#Emph}foes {#Prev}than to what {#Emph}I {#Prev}do with my spear, so we can turn this battle in our favor, finally!

1.Text: Have you yet come to know golden Apollo, Niece? He's so well known and loved among the mortals that he had no choice but to involve himself in our most recent family affair! Bending to mortal pressure like a bow, {#Emph}hah!

2.Text: Oh, come now, Uncle, I don't yield to pressure quite so easily. I just knew this situation would be more than you could handle on your own! We're not just family, we're a team, aren't we?

1.Text: He may not always make for the most {#Emph}pleasant {#Prev}company, but times of {#Emph}peace {#Prev}don't always last, and my good nephew Ares here is excellent to have around for {#Emph}that! {#Prev}Now don't be shy, Ares! Come greet my niece would you?

2.Text: My kin and I are already acquainted, Lord Uncle. Though she may not be overly familiar yet with what we can achieve when we combine your influence over the raging sea with what I do.

1.Text: {#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, my niece, you ought to know that Elder Goddess Demeter and I, we may jeer and jest at one another, but it's never out of spite! Isn't that right, dear foster-sister?

2.Text: Oh, Poseidon! You needn't lie to young Melinoë like that. It sends a terrible impression, and may make her hold you in as much contempt as do I! But let's cooperate for now, why not?

1.Text: My niece, we all must tirelessly work to counteract the harm Chronos has wrought! Some even more tirelessly than the rest! Take, for instance, my nephew Hephaestus here! I told him he could have a word if he got back to hammering after!

2.Text: See how generous our Lord Poseidon is? {#Emph}Everybody {#Prev}needs a decent uncle, I say! Let me know should you ever find one. Now... {#Emph}we {#Prev}here best get back to hammering things out.

1.Text: {#Emph}Ahoy{#Prev}, my little niece, I'm here with the spectacular Queen Hera, fairest wife of my distinguished brother, and all that! Shame I have never found myself a perfect mate as she! {#Emph}You{#Prev}'d bless us if I did, wouldn't you, Hera?

2.Text: {#Emph}Oh{#Prev}, I'll assuredly bless you {#Emph}and {#Prev}your beloved mate whomever they may be, Poseidon. Perhaps when all of this is over, you may resume your search in earnest! But until such time, get your mind out of the gutter.

1.Text: I have known Hestia practically since the cataclysmic day that I was born! Although when things are normal we avoid each other at all costs, she's like an old, wise sister to me at this point, and I am glad she's here! {#Emph}Right {#Prev}here!

2.Text: You {#Emph}best {#Prev}be glad I'm here, you lug! Lest I leave all of you again to fend for your own damn selves. You won't be putting Chronos back into the ground without me, anyhow! That goes for you, too, hot stuff.

1.Text: Our combined might was once {#Emph}more {#Prev}than enough to vanquish Chronos, little Niece! Although it also took the wisdom of my noble brother, Zeus, who formed our plan! We've quite the plan this time as well, don't we, Brother?!

2.Text: Oh, Poseidon, always raring to go. A good plan needn't be discussed out in the open. For now, young Melinoë? We offer you that combined might of ours! Please complicate things for our foes, would you?

1.Text: The only greater strength than that belonging to Lord Zeus, my niece, is his combined with mine! Lightning can surge across my waters even faster than it ravages the land! And now, my kingly brother and I grant our terrifying might to you!

2.Text: We {#Emph}lend {#Prev}our terrifying might to you, that is, Melinoë. For our family is a partnership, and we give as well as take. Now go and use our united strength to take back what's ours!

1.Text: The trident sigil...
The tide's come in!

2.Text: At once, my niece!

1.Text: Oh {#Emph}now {#Prev}you seek my aid?!

2.Text: Well I {#Emph}never!

1.Text: That seafaring {#Emph}brat...

2.Text: That water-loving {#Emph}scamp...

1.Text: Uncle Poseidon!

2.Text: Uncle, it's {#Emph}me!

1.Text: Well this is quite a catch.
I heard so much about you, Uncle, but you're not just very strong, you're generous as well. I am grateful, and would give you this.

2.Text: Oh, little Niece, how {#Emph}thoughtful{#Prev}, but {#Emph}deeply {#Prev}unnecessary! Yet now {#Emph}I'm {#Prev}feeling generous, so here! This one's for you!

1.Text: Uncle Poseidon, it is an honor to have earned your blessing. Especially for all the battles still to come.

2.Text: {#Emph}Hah{#Prev}, well I am left to wonder who it was that taught you such good manners, Niece? You're like a proper little lady, I'm impressed!

1.Text: A little something to soothe the senses, Uncle Poseidon! I know it's hardly the occasion now, but isn't there always some cause to celebrate?

2.Text: You praise your uncle, and your uncle, why, he thinks it's really great! {#Emph}I {#Prev}think it's great, that is! That you would think of gifts in times like these!

1.Text: This one's for you, Uncle! May you shake all our foes from the land, and your seas swallow them, that they rue the day they rose against us!

2.Text: Of all the many sacrifices I have been receiving as of late, and there have been a lot, yours have been the very best of all, my niece!

1.Text: Lord Poseidon! So many mortals know you as the Earth-Shaker, for the land and sea alike bend to your will. But I'm so deeply fortunate to know you as my uncle. I won't forget your kindness and spirit.

2.Text: You needn't waste your Nectar on me, Niece! Not like I can drink it all the way from here. Perhaps that's just how it is with offerings! Mortals, they leave us strips of fresh-cooked meat, and things like that...! What was I on about?

1.Text: I heard the tales of my father's brothers long before we met, Uncle. And you're as mighty and courageous as they say! But I also feel as though you have been looking out for me. Thank you for making me feel welcome and safe.

2.Text: Such a voyage we have had, haven't we, Niece? And you're not even in my same vicinity! Just how it is with relatives. They're with you even when they're not! Know that I'm with you, too, and always making certain that the coast is clear! At least after you find one of my Boons...

1.Text: Dear Uncle Poseidon, this offering of sweet Ambrosia is for you! My father must have been so fortunate to have grown up with such a big-hearted and caring brother. May all your seas and land soon know tranquility again!

2.Text: However did you find such an extravagance amid our tempestuous times, Niece?! All I expected you to do is furiously fight but you have done much more! I move the earth itself; yet you move {#Emph}me.

1.Text: {#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, you seem lovelier than ever, Niece! As though the splendorous Aphrodite herself bestowed to you her gifts! She did so, didn't she, the scamp!
You've met the brilliant Apollo, have you, Niece? He's near as popular with mortals as am I! Perhaps among his many talents he can help you get us out of this!

At last, you've met militant {#Emph}Ares{#Prev}, little niece! Sometimes I think that {#Emph}he's {#Prev}to blame for everything, in all his warring ways! But then if not for him we'd have more difficulty fighting back. So I consider it a wash!

The waters may become a little rough but you have found your sea-legs, right, my niece?
As you embark on your fateful voyage yet again, my niece, know that I am with you, in {#Emph}Boon form!
You go sock that Typhon in the eye for me tonight would you? In {#Emph}all {#Prev}his foul eyes!
We've navigated through rough waters many times! And it never seems to get any easier!

Ask {#Emph}any {#Prev}god upon Olympus whether we think you ought to join in our defense here, or take the fight to Chronos in your father's realm, and you'll get a {#Emph}range of views! {#Prev}A range of {#Emph}highly civil {#Prev}views, which we don't fight about {#Emph}at all!
You're one of my father's brothers, aren't you? Then, help him! {#Emph}In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message!

2.Text: My long-lost niece, {#Emph}you live! {#Prev}We thought you met the same fate as your father! And your mother, {#Emph}and {#Prev}your brother, {#Emph}augh! {#Prev}Well how about we turn the tide, and exact terrible revenge for poor old Hades and his kin?!

1.Text: Perhaps some of the newfangled Boons we've offered haven't always swept you off your feet, but we {#Emph}do {#Prev}still have certain {#Emph}older {#Prev}blessings closer to ones your brother used to get! Why here's a few right now!
No point in holding back even a smidge when we're in such a serious predicament, is there? So here, some of my raw unbridled power ought to {#Emph}tide {#Prev}you over, I should think!
So many of our enemies once feared us gods, but turned their backs on us! I'd say a show of overwhelming force ought to remind them who's the captain of the ship, however, no?
Why, Niece, you're bleeding everywhere! I can't keep watch over your every move, you know! You must be careful, at least until you have some of my might!
{#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, little Niece, you're {#Emph}hurt! {#Prev}But pain builds character, now, does it not? And you are shaping up to be quite a character in all this!
Your injuries shall make you stronger, Niece! Not right away, you're clearly in bad shape right now, but you shall {#Emph}grow {#Prev}from this, I'm sure!
{#Emph}Augh{#Prev}, you must have hit rough waters from the looks of it, but there's good news: {#Emph}I'm {#Prev}here!
An age of mortals is to come? Not if I open up a few more rifts, it won't! {#Emph}Hah! {#Prev}The earth itself could swallow all of those ungrateful little louts, if the seas don't do it first!

I was upset when first I heard the Fates decided they would change things up on us! Have my brothers and I not ruled our realms with strength and gusto? But no use in fighting prophecy... though I may still complain!

Chronos surrendered to us, Niece! You must have heard, you helped {#Emph}deliver {#Prev}him! Yet there remains some mess that must be cleaned? I could not follow what he rambled on about, but if you simply need my Boons, then {#Emph}here!

What is this about having to confront Chronos in other times? And even Typhon {#Emph}too?! {#Prev}I'll not pretend to understand, but if this is the cost of peace, I'll pay my share without a second thought!
I had this feeling you were just about to set forth on another of your fateful escapades! Figured you could use a surge of strength!
A long and treacherous journey begins with a single step, my niece! Or if you're swimming, with a single {#Emph}stroke! {#Prev}Would that swimming were an option, I could aid you even more!
As you set forth, I bid you do as does the shark, my niece! Surely you know the shark? A hunting-fish that swiftly surges ever-forward, in relentless pursuit of its prey!
Let me be first among my kin this eve to bid you a safe voyage through the dark! Not that it's going to be safe, but that's my sentiment, nevertheless!

Oh, thank you, Niece! For we've defeated Typhon with your aid! Although {#Emph}defeated {#Prev}is a bit of a strong word, for it appears we merely knocked him down. Most likely made him angrier. {#Emph}Do {#Prev}make your way back when you can!

What shall it take to put horrendous Typhon down for good?! He can't be reasoned with, recuperates his strength night after night, and has us cornered like a sturgeon in a net! But unlike {#Emph}fish{#Prev}, we can fight tirelessly back!
Grown frustrated trying to take down Chronos, Niece? I know the feeling all too well! But now you're here upon the surface, where Olympus reigns supreme! At least for now!
Now that you've given Chronos something to really think about, you're headed back our way? First, an Underworld victory, and next perhaps one {#Emph}here!

So many of the Titan's legions you have wiped from the face of the earth, my niece! But more must gather in your father's Underworld! Do give them my {#Emph}blessings {#Prev}one of these nights, if you catch my drift!

Did you do it, Niece?! Strange things have happened since the other night; {#Emph}good {#Prev}things, if you are not one of our enemies! We think perhaps you cut old Chronos down to size! But he just grows right back, as I recall!

We've all been counting on you, little Niece, but {#Emph}still! {#Prev}I'd not expected you could take on Chronos and prevail! I thought at best you'd keep him busy for a while. You must be very strong, like {#Emph}me!

When we first met, I promised terrible revenge for what had happened to your kin! And I think what we've done would qualify! So what if Chronos wasn't {#Emph}permanently slain? {#Prev}Neither was old Hades, after all!
Returned for now to more-familiar depths, I see! Well, don't feel bad... the surface-world is not for everyone! Although the risen dead increasingly {#Emph}pretend {#Prev}it is for them!
You've been so focused on setting the Underworld right that I am hesitant to bring it up, Niece, {#Emph}but! {#Prev}Your contributions on the surface would be also welcome here, at any point!
Night after night, victory after victory, {#Emph}haha! {#Prev}You're making all of this look rather {#Emph}easy{#Prev}, Niece! Well then, sail on! And may my blessing make things easier still!
Fear not, Niece, all my anger's washed away as quickly as it swelled. That's emotions for you! The seas themselves are simpler to control!
I got a little heated there I think, but I've cooled off! No lasting harm, though to be fair, my blessing here won't last too long either!
All right, that's enough splashing around, I think! My wrath has ebbed back into the sea that is wherever my wrath is stored!
{#Emph}Eh! {#Prev}Had so much vengeance on the mind, I let you have a little taste back there. Fear not! Only our enemies shall be getting the full course!
I shall count this one as an honest mistake on your part, for I can fathom no other explanation for what transpired here!
Now {#Emph}that {#Prev}is how I like to settle a dispute! Using whichever impressionable creatures are around to make my dissatisfaction known!
{#Emph}Augh! {#Prev}There I go, fighting my kin again, when I ought turn my wrath against our common enemy, who is our kin as well!
Why, you just wiped the {#Emph}floor {#Prev}with all of those has-beens! And just like that, my fury's ebbed away as well!
All right, Niece, I'll let you off with a warning just this once. Or however many times it's been! I've really no idea...
{#Emph}Oh-hoh{#Prev}, this little fishie can bite back! Perhaps I shouldn't be rewarding you for this! But I just cannot help myself!
{#Emph}Augh{#Prev}, all is forgiven, Niece, no need to fret! I was just testing your resolve, and evidently, you have plenty of it still!
Why are we dallying when we have bigger fish to fry? Oh right, because you picked a fight with me! Though does this mean I lost...?
It's Poseidon...

2.Text: He's back...

1.Text: You got it!

2.Text: Oh, very well!

PoseidonRejection01.Text: {#Emph}Augh! {#Prev}You have wounded me, my niece! Not physically, of course, but {#Emph}mentally! {#Prev}Such wounds as heal only with {#Emph}revenge!

PoseidonRejection02.Text: Sailors know the sea can be a moody mistress indeed, and you know why, my little niece? Because {#Emph}I {#Prev}can be a moody {#Emph}mister!

PoseidonRejection03.Text: You reject my blessing, Niece? Well then I'll just have to offer it to whomever else drifts by. Perhaps {#Emph}they'll {#Prev}appreciate it!

PoseidonRejection04.Text: Friendly bit of advice, you turn your back on the sea, you're going to regret it. And the sea in this case is {#Emph}myself!

PoseidonRejection05.Text: There you go again, brushing me aside like a bit of seaweed clinging to your leg! Is that what you take me for, Niece?!

1.Text: I {#Emph}see{#Prev}, you want my blessing {#Emph}still{#Prev}, except a little {#Emph}less {#Prev}than that one you just {#Emph}took! {#Prev}And you want it after a very rousing {#Emph}fight!

PoseidonRejection07.Text: You are swimming in dangerous waters with such antics, Niece. If you so wish to see what lurks in these depths, {#Emph}fine!

1.Text: Oh come {#Emph}on{#Prev}, little niece, it's like you pick against me every single time! It cannot possibly be worth it to incur my wrath!

PoseidonRejection09.Text: I'd not have made that choice if I were you, but then, if I were {#Emph}you {#Prev}I wouldn't still be {#Emph}me{#Prev}, so... {#Emph}augh{#Prev}, you get my drift!

PoseidonRejection10.Text: So, my many different potent blessings just aren't good enough for you? Is that what you would like me to believe?!

1.Text: Now, strictly speaking, Niece, you chose correctly in deferring to my brother Zeus. But I must still save face!
Ladies first, is that the way of it, young Niece? I'm sure Queen Hera is most pleased with you, but I, for one, am not!
Moonlight...
You honor me, Sister.
Selene, I now send to you the Nectar of the gods, that it may warm your passage 'cross the sky!

2.Text: But, little star, you offer this to me? The connection that we share as Silver Sisters is already more than I can ask. Now be that as it may, {#Emph}I {#Prev}have something for {#Emph}you.

1.Text: To you, Selene! I never feel lost knowing the Moon herself is there to help me find my path.

2.Text: You are most kind to honor me this way. It doubtless shall sustain my steeds and me on long nights such as these. You have our thanks.

1.Text: O Moon, my steady friend through all these nights, I have for you this humble offering!

2.Text: I am grateful for your generosity. Though the kinship that we share is more than sufficient, and makes the lonely nights seem to soar by.

1.Text: Great Eye of Night, who watches over me, may your brilliance always shine across the world.

2.Text: The customary gifting of the gods... I am becoming fond of this cycle. Some traditions of Olympus may be worth adopting after all.

1.Text: All creatures need you, Sister, not just gods; from the solitary wolf that howls in the night, to the sailor crossing waters you alone illuminate. You truly are an inspiration.

2.Text: I sometimes think Olympus takes my constancy for granted; for I receive many offerings from mortals, but not gods. While it should make no difference to me, nonetheless it does, little star. Thank you for the gesture.

1.Text: Your silver light is shared by everyone, though I am far more fortunate as I know you yourself, Sister Selene. I never could have found my strength if not for yours.

2.Text: I always wished to be dependable, and you must feel the same. Though I watched over you, out of necessity we were quite distant as you grew and trained, but now? We Silver Sisters have grown close; as though we are one.

1.Text: Sister Selene, Eye of Night, you always have looked out for me since I was very small. But more than that, you've been a dependable comrade and true friend. The gods bestow such gifts to those they cherish, so I offer this to you.

2.Text: On countless nights have I observed your family on Olympus at their feasts, Ambrosia flowing in abundance. But, it was not the place for me, nor do we revel in the Crossroads thus. Yet from you, this is a cherished gift.

1.Text: In my lowest moments, when I felt most incapable and filled with doubt, you always believed in me, Sister. Your cycles across the sky are a steady source of calm and strength and inspiration, for you yourself are all that and more.

2.Text: Thank you for your offering and for your thoughts. I likewise never knew my birthparents when I was small, but Nyx in all her splendor took me in. I saw myself in you, I think, and felt perhaps a big sister could be of benefit...

1.Text: May you shine forever bright, Sister Selene, my big sister, who protected me and guided me and taught me so much of patience and grace. This offering cannot begin to convey how much it means to me to have you in my life.

2.Text: You need not spare such words for me, though I am grateful for them, little star. As for the Ambrosia, I shall keep it for a time we Silver Sisters next may share of it together. As with the bond between us, it shall only grow in quality with age.

1.Text: You bear my Aspect, my Arcana, and my Moon Beam all at once? {#Emph}Oh{#Prev}, little star, you are yourself and need not seek to be like me. Although, perhaps my steeds would welcome a new rider at some point.

Upon the Oath of the Unseen is one Vow that may rise above the rest. It is my charge as Eye of Night to bear it witness, should you choose to speak this Vow of Rivals. Discover the extent of it, and overcome your strongest foes.
I heard you speak the Vow of Rivals at the Oath of the Unseen. Then you shall soon confront your Headmistress in all her dark glory; how she longed that you would gain the strength to face her thus.

You have surpassed each of the two initial obstacles posed by the Vow of Rivals, thus have gained insight with which you may induce still-greater Fear using this Vow. I shall be watching, for you are prepared.
The second Guardians that bar your passage fell to you despite the Vow of Rivals granting them the strength of Night herself. But be forewarned: The Vow's effect shall grow more trying from here on.

You vanquished Cerberus the hound of hell as well as the Titan of Foresight and his ally, in spite of how the Vow of Rivals filled them with such might. I fear, however, that the Vow's full power shall be near-impossible to overcome...

I never thought I would pay witness to what you achieved using the Oath of the Unseen. The Titan Chronos and monstrous Typhon, each laid low, your rivals all surpassed. {#Emph}You {#Prev}are the terror in the Night, not they.

The Oath of the Unseen compels you to exceed your limitations, but do not give in to the temptation to spread greater Fear than you are able to withstand. The Vow of Rivals is about not merely strength, but perseverance.
I watched the goddess Aphrodite seek you out. From her I learned a bit of how to influence the heart. But only when my strength is at its peak, and even then, I fear I pale in comparison.
I see you shine already with another light. The god Apollo's doing, I should think. Fear not; his power is compatible with mine. Light envelops light, never rejecting.
I sense the influence on you of the Arcana for which I am personally known. Then let the magick course through you, and may whichever Hex you manifest lead you to glory.
The god of war decided that his intervention is required, and has granted you some of his violent strength. It may seem difficult to trust in Ares, but his motivations I have found to be quite clear.
You wield the Moonstone Axe, whose broad blade shimmers with my light. Then you must hear the song it sings. Such strength, combined with yours.

I felt a weight drawing me toward the Crossroads recently, and realized it was the Pitch-Black Stone. So then it has awakened... almost like an Eye itself, but far older than mine, and peering from the infinite abyss.

I felt a weight drawing me toward the Crossroads recently, and realized it was the Pitch-Black Stone. So then it has awakened... almost like an Eye itself, but far older than mine, and peering from the infinite abyss.
You have become proficient in concocting Moon Dust in your cauldron, little star. I would relinquish so much more to you, but it would be to no avail without your particular intent.
You bear the mark of Chaos, little star. The most ancient being in existence lost a child to our common foe. Thus, the great creator becomes the great destroyer, through you.
The Titan Chronos, he is Time itself. Thus by his nature, we can never be entirely prepared for him. He seeks the downfall of Olympus, but how exactly, we still do not know.

You have descended into Tartarus, and must have seen what Chronos made of that most-sacred place. I know your confrontation did not go as you desired, but this is a new night. And you are all the more prepared.

Long has the enchantress Circe understood that I do more than merely ride across the sky. She practices her incantations in accordance with the phases of my light; you can depend upon the power she bestows.
I see often the gleaming Sister Blades within your grasp. I knew eventually that they would reawaken and accept you as their bearer. May their swiftness overwhelm your foes.
So many mortals fear the onset of the dark, but we? The dark is merely where we ply our trade. Come forth, then, little star, and let us shine together in the darkness now.
At last you met the goddess of seasons, whose great power often shapes the course of my night's ride. In Demeter, you have a fierce supporter, I can tell.
